articleTitle: LPI Radar Signals Intra-Pulse Modulation Recognition Based on CA-ShuffleNet
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Recently, radar signal recognition methods based on deep learning have achieved great success. However, these approaches still need to be improved due to the limitation of the number of parameters and computation complexity. This paper proposes an intra-pulse modulation recognition approach for low probability of intercept (LPI) radar signal based on time-frequency analysis (TFA) and lightweight convolutional neural network. Through TFA and image preprocessing, the time-frequency images (TFIs) of radar signals are extracted, noise interference is reduced and redundant frequency band is removed. In order to maintain resolution of images and enhance the ability of the network to extract channel and location information, we introduce dilated convolution and coordinate attention (CA) to ShuffleNetV2. And we proposed a joint loss function consisting of center loss and label smoothing loss to alleviate the overfitting problem and make samples cluster better. Simulation results show that the proposed approach can achieve an overall accuracy of recognition of 98.14% when the SNR is -8 dB.

articleTitle: Novel Forward/Backward Signal Space for DOA Estimation of Coherent RF Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Direction of Arrival (DOA) estimation of multiple narrowband RF signals in multipath environments is crucial in real-time applications. In this paper, a novel method is presented to reduce the computational complexity of coherent signals in pairs while maintaining the estimation accuracy. The proposed method employs Cholesky decomposition in conjunction with a novel forward/backward operation (FBO) of the signal subspace matrix to de-correlate the incident signals while the existing methods apply spatial smoothing techniques to the covariance matrix. Employing FBO to the signal space along with Cholesky decomposition will significantly reduce the computational complexity and processing time. These advantages make the proposed method suitable for high-speed communication and real-time applications. Simulation results using Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method and it is compared with Root-MUSIC method as a benchmark.

articleTitle: A Method for Reducing PAPR of OTFS Radar Communication Integrated Signal
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Due to Orthogonal Time Frequency Space (OTFS) technology, which can support reliable information transmission in strong Doppler environments, the integration of radar and communication system based on OTFS is gradually emerging. But OTFS integrated signal has high Peak to Average Power Ratio (PAPR), which degrades the performance of the system heavily. In this paper, the PAPR characteristics of OTFS signals are firstly deduced and evaluated, then a hybrid PAPR reduction algorithm is proposed. It is based on Zadoff-Chu Matrix Transform (ZCMT) and Partial Transmit Sequences (PTS) for reducing P APR. Firstly, an orthogonal precoding matrix is constructed using the Zadoff-Chu sequence, then the data symbols are multiplied by the precoding matrix, and then OTFS signal is divided using the conventional PTS procedure. Finally, the optimal phase rotation factor is selected to reduce the autocorrelation of each sub-data block of the OTFS integrated signal, thus a low P APR OTFS integrated signal is obtained. The simulation results show that the algorithm achieves better P APR suppression performance.

articleTitle: Deep Multi-feature Fusion CNNs with Gemstone Image Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Accurate gemstone classification is critical to the gemstone and jewelry industry, and the good performance of convolutional neural networks in image processing has received wide attention in recent years. In order to better extract image content information and improve image classification accuracy, a CNNs gemstone image classification algorithm based on deep multi-feature fusion is proposed. The algorithm effectively deeply integrates a variety of features of the image, namely the main color features extracted by the k-means++ clustering algorithm and the spatial position features extracted by the denoising convolutional neural network. Experimental results show that the proposed method provides competitive results in gemstone image classification, and the classification accuracy is nearly 9% higher than that of CNN. By deeply integrating multiple features of the image, the algorithm can provide more comprehensive and significant useful information for subsequent image processing.

articleTitle: Implementation of A Real-Time Lossless JPEG-LS Compression Algorithm Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In order to balance image compression ratio, image compression quality and image processing time, an FPGA-based image compression system is proposed. The LOCO-I / JPEG-LS algorithm aims to provide lossless compression ratio, and reduce the overall complexity of the compression algorithm. In this work, the maximum compression ratio can reach 16:1 and average compression ratio can reach 2.61:1 for different input image streams. The maximum operational frequency of the proposed work can reach 103 MHz. Previous FPGA/ASIC-based JPEG-LS compressors bring forward optimization road maps. It is to use pipeline optimization techniques such as forward and look-ahead to split the context update loop, shorten the critical path to increase the clock frequency [1]–[4]. This road map fully explores the pipelining of JPEG-LS but ignores its parallelism potential, which limits the performance at 1 pixel per cycle (PPC). After implementing the algorithm into a Xilinx xc7k70tfbv676-3 FPGA demo board, we propose a new architecture that can process an average of 4 pixels per cycle.

articleTitle: Lightweight YOLOv4 Algorithm for Remote Sensing Image Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Remote sensing images have the characteristics of complex backgrounds, high resolution, and small targets. Although the existing object detection algorithms can improve the detection accuracy, there are generally problems such as a large number of model parameters, high computational cost, and poor real-time performance. Aiming at the above problems, this paper designs a lightweight object detection algorithm GSC-YOLO based on YOLOv4 to achieve fast and accurate detection of remote sensing images. First, Ghostnet is used as the feature extraction network of GSC-YOLO to reduce the number of parameters and improve the detection speed; Secondly, the improved shuffle attention mechanism is introduced in the prediction head to make the model pay attention to important information and improve the detection accuracy; Finally, the Confidence Propagation Cluster algorithm CP-Cluster is used to post-process the prediction frame to improve the object recognition. Taking the preprocessed DOTA dataset as the experimental object, the experimental results show that the GSC-YOLO algorithm has a detection accuracy of 93.44%, a detection speed of 58 frames per second, and a model size of 43.65MB. Compared with the remote sensing image object detection algorithm based on YOLOv4, the detection accuracy is increased by 3.93%, the detection speed is increased by 1.87 times, and the model size is reduced by 5.62 times, which is more suitable for deployment on devices with limited resources.

articleTitle: Power Line Detection Method Based on Broadband Characteristics of FMCW Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Power lines are the biggest threat to helicopters flying at low altitudes, so the detection of power lines is of great significance to helicopter safety. This paper proposes a Bragg feature detection method for power lines based on broadband Bragg features. The method first obtains radar echo data through FMCW broadband data of power lines. Then, the FMCW data is segmented, radar echoes of different frequency bands are formed by distance FFT, and the characteristic points of the candidate power lines echoed in different frequency bands are accurately measured. Finally, through the angle changes of different frequencies, it is confirmed whether it is the Bragg point of the power line, and then the Bragg point characteristics of the power line are identified. This is conducive to solving the problem of false alarms and errors associated with power lines under complex conditions.

articleTitle: DNN Audio Classification Based on Extracted Spectral Attributes
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Recent advances in multimedia systems provide remarkable audio-visual experiences to various fields including entertainment, education, communication, industrial design, etc. To facilitate the audio-visual experience, audio quality enhancement becomes important. However, methods and techniques for improving audio quality highly depend on such audio attributes like human voices, music of different genres, or audio of various programs. This study is devoted to the development of an effective method for real-time audio classification based on deep learning scheme. Three classes of interest include classical music, non-classical music and news. Subband-power distribution (SPD) is a one-dimensional feature based on the audio power in frequency domain, which effectively reflects the spectral attributes of various audio content and allows us to implement DNN (deep neural network) audio classifier in real time. This study develops different DNN models according to various input designs, original SPD of different frequency resolutions and SPD pre-processed by principal component analysis (PCA). Overall accuracy Acc and prediction accuracy of each class using confusion matrix (CFM) will be evaluated to compare the performance. According to our results, the DNN audio classifier implemented with the input SPD pre-processed by PCA not only achieves better performance but remarkably reduces the memory capacity and computational time.

articleTitle: Automotive Millimeter Wave SAR Imaging in Curved Trajectory
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: For automotive Millimeter Wave (MMW) Radar imaging, curved trajectory imaging is inevitable. Compared with other SAR algorithms, the Backproject (BP) algorithm is more suitable for curved line imaging. However, the extensive calculation of BP makes applying to engineering applications with high real-time performance challenging. In this paper, the imaging principle of the traditional BP is introduced. Subsequently, the subaperture BP is proposed, which significantly reduces the redundancy of BP calculation by reasonably selecting the sub aperture imaging grid. Finally, the effectiveness and practicability of the method are verified by actual measurement data.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Signal Processing System for Two-Dimensional Electric Scanning Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: With the progress of technology, phased array radar is more and more widely used. Compared with traditional mechanical scanning radar, phased array radar has the advantages of flexible beam pointing, short response time, high data rate, strong anti-jamming ability and high reliability. The signal processing system of phased array radar is the key to its performance. This paper introduces the hardware design of a two-dimensional electric scanning phased array radar signal processing system. In order to meet the characteristics of phased array radar, we propose a signal processing hardware design scheme based on Xilinx FPGA, kinex-7 and multi-core digital signal processor (DSP). The following experiments and tests show that the signal processing system can meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: A Fusion Location Method for Unmanned Vehicle (UMV) Based on Unscented Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: With the development of automatic pilot technology, the capabilities of automated locating system has become a key indicator in judging the performance of autonomous vehicles. Aiming at improving the drawbacks of low precision and high computational complexity of the fusion locating algorithm applied to Global Navigation Satellite System(GNSS)and Inertial Measurement Unit(IMU) by Extended Kalman Filter(EKF), in this paper, a GNSS and IMU fusion locating method based on Unscented Kalman Filter(UKF) has been proposed to apply to complex traffic environments, and the corresponding loose-coupled fusion locating model has been established. When the functional requirements of vehicle locating accuracy are not high, the loose-coupled fusion locating system can effectively reduce the computational complexity and cost of combined locating system module's research and development. The capability of UKF proposed in this paper has been validated by the simulation experiment with a traffic environment containing three-dimensional roads. Experimental results show that compared with EKF, UKF reduces the error of locating accuracy by 36% and enhances the robustness of the system while improving the accuracy of locating data by 28%, which meets the design needs at a low cost, high precision and high stability in a complex traffic environment.

articleTitle: Joint Radar Node Scheduling and Resource Assignment in Radar Network for Multi-Target Tracking Under Spectrum Coexistence
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: This paper proposes a joint radar node scheduling and resource assignment (JRNSRA) strategy in radar network for multi-target tracking under spectrum coexistence. The main purpose of this strategy is to minimize the multi-target tracking error under several transmit resource budgets of radar network. The expression of the predicted Bayesian Cramer-Rao lower bound (BCRLB) is derived and used to measure the target tracking performance. Since the JRNSRA strategy is a non-convex optimization problem, we propose a two-step solution algorithm to solve the resulting problem. Simulation results show that the JRNSRA strategy can achieve lower multi-target tracking error compared with other strategies under the same spectrum coexistence environment.

Author Keywords: Joint radar node scheduling and resource assignment (JRNSRA)

articleTitle: Waveform Design for MIMO Radar Based on Riemannian Trust Region Method
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: This paper considers waveform design for collocated multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar based on constant envelop (CE) constraint by taking advantage of the Riemannian manifold method. Using the characteristic of the CE constraint, we remodel the original optimization problem as an unconstrained optimization problem on the Riemannian manifold. Then, by exploiting Riemannian trust region manifold, the problem can be solved iteratively. Finally, the optimized waveform can be efficiently generated. Numerical results show the proposed method can suppress interference more heavily and achieve higher SINR compared with the counterparts.

articleTitle: PAPR Suppression for OFDM Integrated Radar and Communication System Based on PTS-Improved Clipping
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is one of the commonly used waveforms of integrated radar and communication systems, but it suffers from some disadvantages, such as the high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR). In order to suppress the PAPR of OFDM, we combine the partial transmit sequence (PTS) method with the improved clipping method. First, we divided the subcarriers into several groups by the partial transmission sequence method. Then each group of subsequences is multiplied by the corresponding phase factor, and the smallest PAPR in subsequences groups is selected. Finally, the PAPR of OFDM integrated radar and communication system reduced furtherly by multiple amplitude limiting iterative filtering. Simulation experiments show that the proposed method can reduce the PAPR by 2.3dB. The ambiguity function changes little after PAPR suppression, and it has little impact on the radar detection performance.

articleTitle: Control Point Compression and Optimization Algorithm Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization in Non-Uniform Rational B-Spline Fitting
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Compression and optimization of control points is a key problem in reverse engineering. This paper proposes a control point compression and optimization algorithm based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm. Firstly, the feature points are selected according to the curvature characteristics of discrete points. Then the maximum error points are selected in turn to add to the type value points, and the least square method is used to obtain the initial control points, and then the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the initial control points. The experimental results show that the algorithm can not only compress the control points to the maximum, but also keep the contour of the curve well, and greatly improve the accuracy of the whole curve under the premise of fewer control points.

articleTitle: Research on Variance-Based FCME Anti-Jaming Algorithm in Spaceborne OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In recent years, Chinese low-orbit satellite communication system has developed rapidly. As a mature waveform transmission technology, OFDM technology is widely used in low-orbit satellite communication systems with the advantages of outstanding resistance to inter-symbol interference, free spectrum and resource allocation, etc. However, for the spaceborne OFDM system, the transmission performance of the system will be seriously affected, whether it is in a civil scenario with unintentional interference or in a complex military confrontation environment with intentional interference. Anti-interference ability is an important factor to ensure the security and stability of the system. Aiming at the problem of narrowband interference in OFDM systems, this paper proposes a variance-based FCME anti-jamming algorithm, which adopts the frequency domain notch structure framework of DFT windowing and overlapping, and uses the variance-based FCME algorithm to detect and notch the interference in the frequency domain. Simulation shows that the algorithm can effectively resist single-tone interference, the bit error rate is lower than 10–6 when EbN0=12dB, and the system performance under narrowband interference can be effectively improved.

articleTitle: Study on Hybrid Encryption Technology of Power Gateway Based on AES and RSA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of security risks of gateways in complex communication networks of power Internet of Things, this paper proposes a hybrid encryption system that combines AES and RSA to ensure the security of power gateway communication. Aiming at the security risks of S-boxes in AES algorithms, this paper proposes a new pair of irreducible polynomials and affine transformations to construct a new S-box, which solves the problems of short iteration cycle of traditional S- boxes and failure to meet strict avalanche criteria. Aiming at the problem of low computational efficiency of RSA algorithm, this paper changes the double prime number to three prime number, and uses the direct modulo power algorithm and Montgomery modulo multiplication to simplify the large number modulo power operation. Experimental results show that the optimized hybrid encryption can ensure both the operation rate and the security of the system.

articleTitle: Multi-Target Detection Based on Improved CA-CF AR Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: To solve the problem of target occlusion in the mean level (ML) constant false alarm rate (CFAR) algorithm under multi-target conditions, an improved cell averaging (CA)-CFAR algorithm is proposed in this paper. First, all the reference cells are divided equally. Then, the mean values of the adjacent sub-reference cells are processed by the ratio discrimination method, and when the ratio is not in the selected interval, the sub-reference cell with a larger mean value is assigned. Finally, a new detection threshold is obtained by calculating the mean value of all the sub-reference cells. Simulation and millimeter wave (mmWave) radar experiments show that, compared with CA-CFAR, the improved CA-CFAR algorithm effectively reduces the detection threshold of multi-target region and solves the problem of missing detection caused by mutual interference between multi-targets, which also proves the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Ambiguity Resolution for Ground-based Pulse-Doppler Radars Using Multiple Medium PRF
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an adaptive method to resolve ambiguities and a ghost target removal process to extract targets detected by a ground-based pulse-Doppler radar using medium pulse repetition frequency waveforms. The ambiguity resolution method is an adaptive implementation of the coincidence algorithm, which is implemented on a two-dimensional (2D) range-velocity matrix to resolve range and velocity ambiguities simultaneously, with a proposed clustering filter to enhance the anti-error ability of the system. Here we consider the scenario of multiple target environments. The ghost target removal process, which is based on the power after Doppler processing, is proposed to mitigate ghosting detections to enhance the performance of ground-based radars using a short PRF schedule in multiple target environments. Simulation results on a ground-based pulsed Doppler radar model will be presented to show the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearing based on Improved Twin Neural Network with Small Samples
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Traditional deep learning methods need big monitoring data as support, however, the real-time fault data that can be obtained is often small samples in most cases. Therefore, an improved twin neural network model based on small samples is proposed. Taking the traditional twin neural network as the backbone, in the feature extraction stage, the deep belief neural network (DBN) and convolution neural network (CNN) are used to extract the temporal and spatial features of fault signals, which can fully mine the feature information on data samples. Secondly, the fault diagnosis classification module is added, and the convolutional neural network with the first layer of wide convolution (WDCNN) faults diagnosis algorithm model is introduced to fully classify the fault data. The experimental results show that the fault diagnostic accuracy of the improved twin neural network model on the training set and the test set is more than 98%. The visualization of t-SNE classification shows that it has a good effect on the classification of all kinds of tagged fault data. The comparison of the confusion matrix shows that the improved twin neural network model can effectively improve the problem of various fault misclassification compared with the original model, greatly reduced the diagnostic error, and meet the accuracy requirements of fault diagnosis in case of small samples.

articleTitle: Improvements on Robustness of Feedback Active Noise Reduction Earphone
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In feedback active noise control with fixed controllers, noise reduction performance and stability of feedback system are affected by changes on secondary path. For active noise reduction earphones, disturbance and uncertainty of the secondary path will be caused if the tightness or direction of the earphones changes. Therefore, it is necessary to measure several secondary paths to obtain one nominal secondary path before designing controllers, and the constrain on the stability of the feedback system should be made to ensure the robustness of the system. In this paper, improvements are made on the selection of nominal secondary path and disturbance weighting function on the basis of robust control theory. The optimized method makes it possible to achieve higher noise reduction on the premise of ensuring the stability of the feedback system. The robustness of feedback system is improved, and the maximum disturbance to noise reduction performance is reduced.

articleTitle: An Improved Convolution Algorithm of Cylinder String Based on Unified Coordinate System
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Tube string convolution algorithm is a commonly used dose verification algorithm in radiotherapy. It has the advantages of fast operation time, high verification accuracy, and no need for specific structural parameters of the accelerator head for modeling. However, it is often necessary to establish a ray coordinate system for each ray and divide the cylinder string area in the ray coordinate system, which makes the algorithm involve multi coordinate system conversion and other issues. In this paper, a CCC algorithm in a unified coordinate system is proposed to solve this problem. On the premise of not affecting the verification accuracy, the affected points and their outer point coordinates are used to divide the cylinder string area, avoiding the problem of coordinate conversion in multiple coordinate systems, and simplifying the algorithm modeling process.

articleTitle: Marine Target Detection by Exploiting Multi-Circle Features with Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Marine target detection with coastal radars is challenging, due to the strong sea clutter and the sidelobe of land clutter and city clutter. The non-uniform non-stationary and non-Gaussian clutter degrades the performance of traditional power-based threshold detection methods based on the statistical signal processing theory. Most recent works on the feature-based target detection methods relies on the time-frequency features, which may be unavailable for short-dwell-time applications. Therefore, this work develops a new multi-dimensional feature of targets, multi-circle feature, without limitation of the dwell-time length. A convolutional neural network (CNN) is employed to discriminate true targets and false alarms after the low-threshold detection in energy domain. The experimental results exhibit that the proposed CNN-based detection can achieve a nearly 80% reduction in false-alarm rate without the loss in detection rate compared to the traditional threshold detection.

articleTitle: A Method of Virtual Array Aperture Extension for FMCW MIMO Phase-Coded Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In the multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) phase-coded radars, the virtual array aperture (VAA) depends on the maximum physical distance between the transmitting and receiving antenna. Most of the existing VAA extensions focus on the phase compensation of echoes, which introduce no extra resources in terms of the transmitting waveforms. In this paper, we proposed a method to extend the VAA by taking advantage of the phase modulation of the inter-pulse phase coding radar. This method continuously applies phase modulation to the transmitting waveforms to introduce extra azimuth information. Under this premise, less prior information and phase compensation are needed to utilize the digital beam forming (DBF) due to the pre-modulation. Moreover, the proposed method is based on binary phase modulation (BPM), in which case the modulation complexity is effectively suppressed. The effectiveness of the proposed methods is demonstrated through simulation results and experiments.

articleTitle: SAR-GMTI Simulation of T72 Based on DPCA
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The traditional Synthetic Aperture Radar(SAR) system is a remote sensing system designed for static targets on the ground. When there is a Doppler mismatch caused by target motion, it will blur and offset the pixel. SAR-GMTI is a synthetic aperture radar system that can indicate, locate and indicate moving targets on the ground. And it makes a positive difference in counter-terrorism activities, refugee control, anti-smuggling at sea, and traffic control in the cities. There are two mainstream dual-channel SAR-GMTI technologies, one is Displaced Phase Center Antenna(DPCA) and another is Along Track Interferometry(ATI). SAR-GMTI based on DPCA can be applied to detect and track maneuvering tactical targets from complex scenes on the ground, which has great strategic value. This paper initially takes a T-72 tank from MSTAR Dataset as the simulation target and analyzes the influence of radial velocity and transverse velocity on imaging. Then DPCA technique is used to detect the moving target in strong clutter. The conclusions of the experiment show that DPCA can detect targets effectively in strong clutter, which provides theoretical support for the engineering application of ground-moving target indication.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Disturbance Observer-Based Sliding Mode Controller for Underwater Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: To improve the performance of rejecting disturbances for underwater vehicles, a nonlinear disturbance observer-based sliding mode controller is proposed. Specifically, the proposed control framework simultaneously utilizes the insensitivity to the disturbances of the sliding mode controller and the disturbance compensation ability of the disturbance observer. Besides, a series of rigorous mathematical analyses are provided to indicate the stability of the proposed controller. Finally, the results of the simulation demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: OPTICS-Based Passive Tracking Algorithm for High Maneuvering Targets
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: For the high maneuvering target, its motion mode is unknown in advance, so the passive target tracking algorithm using fixed motion model or interactive multi-model cannot match the actual motion mode of the maneuvering target. In order to solve the problem of low tracking accuracy caused by unknown motion model of high maneuvering targets, an OPTICS-based passive tracking algorithm for high maneuvering targets was proposed. The algorithm estimates the target state by using the OPTICS trajectory clustering algorithm when the tracking error is large, and updates the state transition matrix based on the motion model estimates and multi-station passive sensor observations. The simulation results verify that the OPTICS-based passive tracking algorithm for high maneuvering targets proposed in this paper can effectively improve the tracking accuracy of high maneuvering targets, which is beneficial to the realization of low probability of interception tracking.

articleTitle: Design of Modified VI -CFAR and Implementation on Zynq
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The performance of the traditional variability index constant false alarm rate (VI-CFAR) algorithm will degrade when there are interference targets in both the leading and lagging reference windows. To solve the problem, this paper draws on the quality of logarithmic detector to utilize logarithmic data to execute the smallest-of CFAR (SO-CFAR), to propose a modified VI-CFAR. The performance of MVI-CFAR is evaluated with simulated and trial data. Among them, the processing of the trial data is realized based on Zynq, and the overall scheme of radar data reading, writing and processing is innovatively designed, whose effectiveness and processing accuracy meet the requirements. Experimental results show that MVI-CFAR has a stable anti-interference and false alarm control capability in the multi-target and clutter edge environment respectively, proving to be a robust detector. It can also be effectively used for sea surface target detection, which shows certain engineering value.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis and Research of Virtual Reality Digital Museum
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Museums are the central pivot knot of cultural exchange and dissemination, and have an important role in promoting culture, propaganda, and education. With the continuous innovation of science and technology, virtual reality technology has been more and more widely used. In recent years, due to the epidemic, the development of virtual reality digital museums has been rapid and recognized by the audience, but the rapid development has also led to the uneven quality of virtual reality digital museums, thus causing the audience's use experience is also mixed, in order to solve the problems of the use experience, the thesis through the existing virtual reality digital museums to organize and classify, for the virtual reality digital museums the paper extracts three main factors, including sensory experience, interactive experience and emotional experience, and constructs a model of virtual reality digital museum experience. Through questionnaire survey and AMOS data analysis, the characteristics of adopting virtual reality technology in digital museums are explained, and the inadequacy of considering user experience in the development and design process of current virtual reality digital museums is pointed out, and then the improvement suggestions of virtual technology in digital museums are proposed to promote the development of virtual reality digital museums.

articleTitle: A Frequency Invariant Broadband Beamformer Based on Directional Microphone Array
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The performance of a frequency invariant broadband beamformer based on an omnidirectional microphone array will suffer great reduction at low frequencies. To overcome it, in this paper, we explore the potential of directional microphone arrays to provide more degrees of freedom to the frequency invariant broadband beamformer design. On this basis, a more general expression of the optimal weights is given regardless of the microphone type or the array geometry. Several examples are presented to show that the proposed beamformer can bring about comparatively superior performance in robustness, directivity and frequency invariance.

articleTitle: Precise Method for U-Array Orientation Based on Split Beam
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a precise orientation method for U-array based on split beams, which identifies the relationship between the incident angle deviation and the time delay deviation of different beams for U-array. U-array is quite distinct from uniform line array or arc array and thus entails new challenges. Our method leverages the relationship of typical and atypical beams in linking-up segments between arc and straight line on U-array to obtain the expected direction of arrival. Moreover, our method can be applied to multi-target tracking on conformal array sonar.

articleTitle: Aperture Resource Optimization Method for Low Sidelobe Linear Opportunistic Array Based on PSO-CVX Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In this paper, a joint optimization method is proposed that comprehensively considers the low sidelobe pattern synthesis problem and the aperture resource saving problem of linear opportunistic array. Firstly, the fuzzy stochastic simulation algorithm is used to solve the uncertainty in the chance-constrained programming model. Then the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to select the working array elements. As the array aperture is fixed, the convex optimization algorithm is used as the local algorithm to obtain the best excitation coefficient. The simulation results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can obtain lower sidelobe level under the condition of saving aperture resources.

articleTitle: Block Space-Time Coding for Underwater Optical Massive MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The complex underwater environment will cause high attenuation and random fading of the transmitted optical signal. This paper proposes a space-time block coding (STBC) technique for this problem. The massive multiple-input multiple-output (Massive-MIMO) underwater wireless optical communication (UWOC) system is subjected to block coding processing. The STBC coding technology is used in the blocks, respectively, and the spatial multiplexing technology is used between the blocks. Through the use of Massive-MIMO technology to improve the capacity of the communication system, combined with STBC coding technology to further improve the reliability of the communication system, and the communication link of the Massive-MIMO system is fully utilized. The simulation results show that the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is improved by about 4dB when the bit error performance (BER) of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{4}\times \mathbf{4}$</tex> STBC is 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup> higher than that of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{2}\times \mathbf{2}$</tex> STBC in a weak turbulent environment. In a strong turbulent environment, when the system SNR is 10dB, the BER of the multiplexing system using block STBC coding can reach 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup>.

articleTitle: Improved Minimum Description Length CFAR Based on Weighted Log-Likelihood Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Minimum description length CFAR (MDL-CFAR) can improve the detection performance in clutter edge environment, but the detection performance is poor in multi-target environment. In this paper, an improved minimum description length CFAR based on weighted log-likelihood estimation is proposed. The minimum description length method is used for clutter edge location determination, and the final selected sample data set is subjected to weighted log-likelihood estimation to obtain the background clutter power estimate. Comparing the advantages and disadvantages of CFAR algorithm based on minimum description length and CFAR detection algorithm based on weighted log-likelihood estimation, the proposed improved minimum description length CFAR based on weighted log-likelihood estimation (WLL-MDL-CFAR), which combines the advantages of WLL-CFAR and MDL-CFAR algorithms, effectively improves the detection performance in different environments. And at the same time, the ability to maintain a constant false alarm in the clutter-edge environment is guaranteed.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Ship Equipment Multifactor Coupling System Based on the Enhanced Dematel-ANP Method
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In the traditional research on the reliability of ship equipment, most of them only analyze the attributes of equipment, evaluate the performance and analyze the reliability by using the equipment degradation data, and rarely study the influence of external environmental factors on the equipment performance. Considering the environment of the ship equipment, based on the scientific theory of open complex giant system, the reliability analysis of the ship equipment as an open complex giant system is carried out, and the multi-element coupling model of“ one subject four elements“ system is established. To analyze the health status of multi-attribute ship equipment system, the system reveals the coupling effect and influence of equipment attributes, environmental factors, maintenance intervention and other equipment multi-element on the health evolution of a complex equipment. By improving the traditional DEMATEL-ANP method, the established system multi-element coupling relationship matrix is introduced to replace the direct impact matrix, and the equipment attributes, environmental factors Conduct quantitative evaluation on the coupling effect and impact of maintenance intervention and other equipment multi factors on the health evolution of a certain equipment. Through experimental verification, it can be seen that the proposed system multi-element coupling model and the improved method can quickly and accurately analyze the coupling relationship and influence among the various elements of the marine engine system, and at the same time, it can quantitatively evaluate the impact in time to determine the key elements.

articleTitle: Power Allocation Algorithm Considering Qos and Max-Min Fairness in Single-Beam UVLC System
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: To meet the service requirements of different users in a single beam, we divide the system's users in a single beam into two categories named edge users and fair users. We also propose a power allocation algorithm that guarantees the quality of service (QoS) for edge users and fairness for fair users. For these two types of users, an optimization model of power distribution under the constraints of specific LED emission power is established, which ensures the user QoS for edge users and the max-min fairness for fair users. Using the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) condition and the bisection method, we obtain the optimal power allocation expression for the two types of users in the optimization model. Through simulation, we verify that the proposed user classification and power allocation method can ensure the fairness of fair users on the premise of ensuring the QoS of edge users. At the same time, we know that the number of users will affect the improvement of the minimum rate, and the throughput of the non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) system is greatly improved compared with the traditional orthogonal multiple access (OMA) systems.

articleTitle: Farm Parcel Extraction in Remote-Sensing Images Based on Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Vectorized and structured data extracted from farm parcel segmentation and classification provides basic information for the research on pest control of large areas, crop yield forecasts, and crop varieties classification. On one hand, we investigate the effectiveness of an automated image segmentation method based on DeeplabV3+ architecture to enable it to automate the task of farm parcel delineation that originally relied on high labor costs. On the other hand, we detail an efficient post-processing on vectoring binary segmentation image to get more optimized image segmentation results. Overall, on the 0.8m resolution image dataset, the precision reaches 85.22%, the recall reached 83.78<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, the F1-S was 81.08%, the accuracy was 82.54%, and IoU was 82.87%. Meanwhile, without losing too much precision, we train and test the model with 3.2m resolution images, which has the advantage of processing speed over 0.8m resolution. The method can be effectively applied to the task of segmentation of agricultural land. Extensive experiments show the effectiveness of using the DeeplabV3+ architecture and post-processing by vectoring binary segmentation for farm parcel segmentation in high remote sensing images.

articleTitle: Research on Detection Performance of Distributed PA-MIMO Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: This paper proposes a hybrid distributed phased array-multiple input and multiple output (PA-MIMO) radar system, which is a compromise combination of phased array radar and MIMO radar. Firstly, we establish a target detection model based on the Neyman-Pearson criterion for the radar system. Secondly, a likelihood ratio detector is derived with the overall consideration of channel reciprocity and multi-pulse phase parameter accumulation shared by subarray transceivers. Then, the closed-form expression for detection probability is obtained and compared with the other four typical MIMO radar and phased array radar. Finally, simulation experiments and the results comparison are provided to verify that the hybrid distributed MIMO radar system effectively improve the target detection performance of the radar system using both spatial diversity gain and phase reference gains.

Author Keywords: hybrid distributed phased array-multiple input and multiple output (PA-MIMO)

articleTitle: The Analysis of Vibro-Acoustic Coupling Theory of a Complex Plate-Cavity Model
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In this paper, a research is conducted to model the vibro-acoustic coupling characteristics of a plate-cavity system coated with viscoelastic multilayers. With the application of multi-media acoustic impedance method and wave number expansion, analytical results on sound and vibration of the coupling system induced by a point excitation, is presented on modal expansion method. A detailing research on the physical law of plate vibration and cavity noise induced by the parameters of plate and viscoelastic multilayers is carried out via numerical calculation. For further study, the analysis of vibration and noise supreession of the viscoelastic multilayers is also studied. The results show that the changing of the parametres of plate and viscoelastic multilayers may somewhat affect the vibro-acoustic coupling characteristics of plate-cavity system. Otherwise, the vibration and noise reduction induced by acoustical coating mainly works in the middle and high frequency segment in an aqueous medium.

articleTitle: Deployment Optimization for Search Task in Netted Radar System Under Region Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: This paper studies a deployment optimization method of netted radar systems under radar location constraints. The key idea is to improve the search capability by radar deployment optimization. We first adopt the surveillance region as the metric function to gauge targets' searching performance. Then, various constraints are considered and the optimization model is introduced as a nonconvex optimization problem. To solve this problem, we use the simulated annealing (SA) algorithm to acquire the deployment optimization scheme. Finally, simulation results demonstrate that the deployment proposed can enlarge netted radar systems' detection area, which verifies the validity of the radar deployment scheme proposed.

articleTitle: A LEACH Energy Consumption Equilibrium Optimization Method Based on Multiple Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: LEACH (low energy adaptive clustering hierarchy) protocol is the first clustering protocol proposed in WSN, aims to balance network energy consumption, and prolong network lifetime. However, the LEACH algorithm randomly selects cluster heads without considering the location information and node density of nodes, and the single-hop transmission method is only suitable for small-scale networks. Although LEACH-ED and EEUC protocols are equal structured nonuniform clustering, they do not consider the location of special nodes near the base station. In this paper, the LEACH optimization algorithm based on multi-impact factor is proposed, the threshold function is improved, and the next hop path of the node is selected by multi-hop routing between clusters based on energy and location information. In addition, the changes of different base station locations after adding the impact factor are compared. The results show that the optimization method in this paper makes the network energy consumption more balanced, prolongs the network lifetime, and reduces the influence of base station location on the network.

Author Keywords: LEACH protocol sensor node information network energy consumption balance

articleTitle: Improved DFT Based DOA Estimation for Wideband Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Recently, with the widespread applications of wideband signals, the research on wideband direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation has been investigated intensively. In this paper, we propose a wideband DOA estimation method based on improved Discrete Fourier transform (DFT). Firstly, we establish improved DFT matrices to aggregate the results of all frequency bins to obtain initial DOA estimations. Thereafter, we compensate the estimation offsets via total least squares (TLS) constructed from Taylor expansion approximation of all frequency bins together. Besides, the compensation method can be implemented iteratively to strengthen the estimation results. Multiple simulations are conducted to verify the proposed method, which exhibits satisfactory performance in comparison to the existing wideband DOA estimation algorithms. In addition, the proposed method has also been verified by real data test and has shown favorable results.

articleTitle: EVM Based HF Adaptive Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: High frequency (HF) communications may face interference, and the conventional signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) based adaptive modulation cannot fully reflect the HF channel state information. This paper proposes an error vector magnitude (EVM) based adaptive modulation mechanism for HF communication. EVM is first demonstrated that it can be applied to the design of HF adaptive modulation system where interference may be present. On this basis, the EVM threshold can be determined under the constraint by the relationship between EVM and symbol error rate, and then the design of the adaptive modulation mechanism is completed. Simulation results further show that EVM can better characterize HF channel state and interference, and is suitable as a channel state parameter for HF communication systems. In particular, compared to traditional SNR based adaptive modulation, the proposed approach can get higher spectrum utilization while the complexity is kept low.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Recognition Based on YOLOv5 Network Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low recognition accuracy, slow rate, missed detection and false detection of traditional target detection algorithm in traffic sign recognition system, The deep learning technology can extract the feature information of traffic sign automatically, so a traffic sign target detection algorithm based on YOLOV5 network structure is proposed. The attention mechanism is added to enhance the effective features of the detected objects, suppress the interference features, and improve the performance of traffic sign detection in the complex background. The results show that survey data for training and testing were collected from China TT100K, and the optimized YOLOv5 algorithm has a good detection effect.

articleTitle: Time-Constrained Multi-UAVs Mission Planning Method
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Aiming at the mission planning problem of multi-UAVs cooperative operations, a Time-constrained Self-Organizing Allocation Algorithm (TSOAA) based on time constraint rules is designed and proposed, which solves the problem of the limited capacity of multi-UAVs. The problem of task allocation under the control system improves the performance of multi-UAVs tasks. In this paper, the multi-UAVs cooperative mission planning problem is transformed into the classic multi-travelling salesman MTSP problem, and the UAV model, mission model and revenue objective function are designed and proposed, and the multi-UAVs mission planning scheme of typical scenarios is solved according to the algorithm model.. The simulation results show that under the condition of limited bomb load, the TSOAA algorithm can effectively solve the waiting and conflict problems in the multi-UAVs task assignment process, shorten the task execution time and route distance, and ensure the optimal performance of the task execution. It has certain practical value and guiding significance for multi-UAVs cooperative combat mission planning.

articleTitle: A Method for Processing Unwanted Target Caused by Reflection in Secondary Surveillance Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Along with the development of secondary surveillance radar (SSR) in air traffic surveillance systems, the multipath phenomenon has always been a noticeable problem. This article discusses the geometrical aspect and power aspect of the multipath interference caused by reflection in SSR and proposes a method to deal with these unwanted multipath targets (ghosts) by false-target position predicting and adaptive false-target suppressing, which has been implemented in a SSR's processing system with significant performance since all multipath targets are addressed exactly and suppressed online. A field-experiment example is mentioned at the end of the article to demonstrate the efficiency of this measure.

articleTitle: A Multi-scale Network Based on Compound Extended Coding UNet++ for Polyp Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Computer-aided segmentation has been widely used in clinic since it helps to quickly locate the region of interest (ROI) in medical images. At present, a large number of segmentation algorithms have been proposed based on convolutional neural networks in past decades. However, they are difficult to popularize in segmentation of complex and diverse targets such as Intestinal polyps. In this paper, an efficient segmentation model of parallel multi-scale networks based on compound extended coding UNet++ is proposed. Specifically, a multi-scale parallel strategy is designed to extract multi-level features from multiple branches of the segmentation network for fusion, in which each branch network is constructed by combining EfficientNet encoder and UNet++ decoder. The proposed model is applied on the public CVC-ClinicDB dataset and achieves the mean Dice of 0.9344, IoU of 0.8440, sensitivity of 0.9113 and precision of 0.9211, exhibiting more promising performance than some state-of-the-art methods in polyp segmentation from colonoscopy images.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Key Generation Method based on Phase Characteristics of Wireless Channel
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: With the development of wireless communication technology, the application of the physical layer key generation method based on channel characteristics is becoming more and more widespread. In this method, the selection of quantization algorithm in the quantization stage is particularly important. The poor performance of the initial key will affect the efficiency of key reconciliation, and even cause the failure of the whole key generation method. In the existing quantization algorithms, the quantization level and guard interval are fixed, so the performance of the initial key cannot always be optimized in the face of complex and changeable communication environment. Aiming at the above problems, this paper combines the adaptive adjustment of quantization level and guard interval effectively on the basis of existing multi-bit quantization algorithm. This method continues the method of deleting eigenvalues by index value in multi-bit quantization algorithm, which improves the consistency of initial key. Based on information theory, this method selects optimal quantization level on the premise that the initial key is theoretically error-free under different SNR. This method sets the guard interval based on the average error probability of the eigenvalue and the quantization level, which solves the problem of deleting too many eigenvalues when the SNR is high in the method of setting fixed guard interval. Simulation results show that this method is feasible.

articleTitle: A Research on Acoustic Hear-Through Technology Based on an Active Noise Cancellation Headphone System
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Since in-ear headphones have high-level isolation, ambient sounds that transmit to the human eardrum are attenuated as they pass through the headphones. Acoustic Hear-Through (HT) or acoustic transparent transmission technique is used to enable natural listening of ambient sounds while wearing headphones. Based on the structure of in-ear headphones with active noise cancellation, this paper presents the design of an acoustic HT digital filter and embeds the headphone system with HT function. Combined with the speech spectral subtraction algorithm, the speech enhancement is applied based on the HT system to achieve selective HT of noisy speech. Compared with the acoustic transfer functions in the natural listening environment and the no HT headphone-wearing environment, the proposed HT headphone performs well in reducing the attenuation of the headphone system. Finally, the idea that the proposed selective HT function has great potential to improve the quality and intelligibility of the noisy speech heard by the eardrum is verified.

articleTitle: An Underwater Non-free Field Sound Radiation Prediction Technology Based on Sound Field Separation
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Traditional measurement techniques have limitations in the low-frequency range of underwater non-free field. In this paper, a sound field separation measurement technique based on “Supersonic Intensity in Reverberant Environments“ (SIRE) is adopted, which separates the outward and inward waves of the underwater sound source in unknown field conditions, and filters out the evanescent waves and calculates the radiated sound power. The radiated sound power of pulsating spherical source in an underwater non-free field is numerically calculated by the finite element method (FEM), and the accuracy of the algorithm is verified by comparison with the analytical solution. The prediction of the radiated sound power of the elastic cylindrical shell in the low-frequency range in the underwater non-free field is realized, and the influence of the measuring radius of the holographic surface and the measuring points on the measuring accuracy is analyzed. The results show that this technique is accurate in calculating the radiated sound power of underwater sound source in the low-frequency range of non-free field, and provides necessary conditions for vibration reduction and noise reduction of the underwater sound source.

articleTitle: Phase Error Analysis of Moving Target in Bistatic SAR FBP Imagery
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In this paper, the phase error analysis of the moving target in bistatic synthetic aperture radar (SAR) filtered backprojection (FBP) imagery has been studied. Different from the conventional approach where phase error analysis is performed in the phase history domain, in this paper, we provide a detailed analysis of the 2-D phase error in the wavenumber domain after FBP formulation. The components of residual 2-D phase error in the wavenumber domain and their relationship are revealed. Based on the prior knowledge, the signatures of the moving target in FBP imagery can be predicted due to the Fourier relationship between the wavenumber domain and image domain. Finally, the simulation experiments are carried out to verify the predicted signatures of the moving target in FBP imagery.

articleTitle: Enhanced Truncated Statistic CFAR Based on Median Absolute Deviation and Weighted Log-likelihood Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The actual working environment of radar is complex, including many interferences and non-homogeneous clutter, which seriously degrade the detection performance of radar. This paper proposes an enhanced truncated statistic CFAR (ETS-CFAR) based on median absolute deviation and weighted log-likelihood estimation. The algorithm has good detection performance in multi-target environment, and moreover, ensures good performance in clutter edge environment, which has a good ability to maintain a constant false alarm rate. The median absolute deviation is applied to improve the estimation of truncation depth, which is a robust measure and insensitive to the outlier, and the statistical interference outliers are eliminated. The weighted log-likelihood estimation is adopted to optimize the determination conditions of the weighted coefficients and improve the parameter estimation of the clutter. The proposed ETS-CFAR algorithm is evaluated in different clutter environments through simulation, and the superiority of the algorithm is explained.

articleTitle: Pattern Synthesis of High-Order Sideband Suppression for Time-Modulated Conformal Array Based on Sequential Convex Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In this paper, an efficient method for high-order sideband suppression and beam pattern synthesis of time-modulated conformal array antenna is proposed. First, the mathematical model of the center frequency band and first-order sideband beamforming and higher-order sideband gain suppression are established. Then, a Taylor expansion is performed to approximate the far-field radiation intensity of the higher-order sideband. Finally, the optimal solution is obtained by sequential convex optimization algorithm. The simulation results of the time-modulated cylindrical array antenna show that the method has excellent sideband suppression ability.

articleTitle: Robust Dual Target Range Estimation Method of Vertical Array Using Residual Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In the actual marine environment, it is often necessary to locate multiple underwater targets at the same time. Aiming at the problem of simultaneous localization of multiple sound sources, this paper studies the double target range estimation scene in the same depth and uses normal wave model to generate the underwater acoustic data of dual targets. The range estimation of dual targets in the same sea area and different sea areas is carried out, and two frequency combinations of dual targets, namely 280/385Hz and 49/388Hz, are taken as examples to analyze the impact of different frequencies on the range estimation results. The network structure adopts the convolution neural network (CNN) with residual connection. The simulation results show that the residual CNN model can effectively realize the range estimation of dual targets in the same sea area and different sea areas, and the greater the frequency difference, the more accurate the range estimation results of the dual targets. Therefore, all results show that the proposed method has excellent performance for the dual target range estimation.

articleTitle: Joint Source Channel Symbol Level En/Decoding Based on Space Computational Intelligence Policy Trellis
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Joint source channel symbol-level en/decoding based on space computational intelligence (CI) policy trellis is presented. Through constructing a joint decoding plane trellis, it can achieve better decoding performance than the bit-level decoding algorithm. However, the plane trellis is complicated, which results in a high decoding complexity for decoding symbol - level Turbo codes. To solve this problem, we construct a space CI policy trellis and its optimization design of weight value by using constraint condition system of equation in this paper and design a low-complexity joint decoding with variable length symbol-A Posteriori Probability (VLS-APP) algorithm. Simulation results show that the proposed approach reduces the decoding complexity compared to the plane trellis, and the gain is about 1.3 dB, and it provides substantial error protection for variable-length encoded image data, which can be applied to the joint symbol-level en/decoding of streaming media in resource-constrained space communication.

articleTitle: MCQG: Multitask Approach for Chinese Question Generation and Question Answering
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Question generation and question answering are complicate and require us do more reading comprehension. In this work, we finetuned a multilingual T5(mT5) Transformer in a multitask setting for question generation, question answering using Chinese SQuAD datasets. In the multitask setting, we trained the model to perform answer extraction, question generation and question answering tasks simultaneously. We use one model do all the tasks. To our best knowledge, this is the first academic work that performs end-to-end question generation and question answering from Chinese texts. The experiments evaluations shows that the multitask QG and QA approach is effective and has greater performance than single task setting.

articleTitle: An Underwater Wideband Multi-Highlight Active Target Velocity Estimation Method Based on Cepstrum and Matched Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-highlight target echo model is investigated, and the target is considered to be of a constant relative velocity to the sonar. The echo is usually equivalent to the superposition of reflections from single highlight. Due to the relative motion of the active sonar and the target, the echo is stretched or compressed. Moreover, noise and reverberation are existed in the underwater environment. All of the above degrade the performance of the target velocity estimation. As a nonlinear signal operation method, cepstrum can change the convolution operation in time domain into the summation operation in the cepstrum domain. Based on the good performance of cepstrum operation in detecting periodic signals, a cepstrum-based target velocity estimation method is proposed. In this method, a combined pulse signal is transmitted, and the received echo is successively subjected to Matched Filter and cepstrum operation, the position of the peak in the cepstrum domain is searched to estimate the velocity of the target. Simulation results demonstrated that the proposed method can estimate the target velocity precisely at low signal-to-noise ratio using small computational effort.

articleTitle: Multiple Watermarking Based on DCT Coefficients Selection
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: This paper proposes a multiple watermarking scheme based on Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) coefficients selection. In the proposed method, the multiple watermarks are embedded into the low and / or middle frequency band in DCT domain of the image blocks. Firstly, the texture complexity is calculated, then based on that, two block selection methods are proposed to select the corresponding adjacent blocks. After that, embedding coefficients and reference coefficients are calculated and the multiple watermarks are embedded by adjusting the difference of projection of embedding coefficients and reference coefficients on the spreading vector. In this way, the embedding efficiency is thus improved. In the experiments, cover images of different texture complexity are used, and various attacks have been simulated for evaluation of the proposed watermarking scheme. Experimental results show that the proposed multiple watermarking scheme can achieve a satisfied performance.

articleTitle: Adaptive Resolution Imaging Algorithm for Helicopter-Borne Arc Antenna Array Based on Grid Layout Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The imaging of arc array radar is complicated due to its special structure. Backward projection (BP) is a high-resolution imaging algorithm, which can solve the coupling problem of range and azimuth in the arc antenna array SAR imaging. However, BP algorithm has huge computation and nonuniform image resolution distribution in the imaging of arc array antenna radar. In this paper, an improved BP algorithm for arc antenna array imaging is studied. By redesigning and optimizing the grid layout, the image resolution balance in the arc imaging region can be achieved, and the grid layout can be adjusted according to the required image resolution adaptively. The computation of the algorithm before and after adaptive adjustment are analyzed and compared, which shows the computation of the improved algorithm is reduced significantly. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Measurements and Analysis of Fading Characteristics for Narrow-Beam Channel in Vehicle-to-Infrastructure Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Narrow-beam formed by dynamic beamforming of massive multiple-input multiple-output antenna is an emerging technology to support advanced use cases and higher intelligent levels in 5G new radio-vehicle-to-everything (5G-V2X). A comprehensive and accurate understanding of fading characteristics for narrow-beam channel is crucial to the application of the 5G-V2X communication technology. This paper investigates measurement and characterization of the narrow-beam channel in vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) scenarios. A series of 3.35 GHz narrow-beam channel measurements in two typical V2I scenarios are employed. Based on the measured data, the fading characteristics of narrow-beam V2I channel including path loss, shadow fading and K-factor are extracted and analyzed, and the empirical models are established. These results will provide valuable reference for the deployment and evaluation of 5G-V2X communication systems

articleTitle: Detection and Recognition of Dynamic Human Postures in Non-Line-of-Sight Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Detection of dynamic human postures in non-line-of-sight (NLOS) region is implemented by using 77GHz linear frequency modulated continuous wave (LFMCW) radar. The recognition is performed by combining enhanced time-frequency posture features with transfer learning technique. By analyzing and denoising the radar echo signals from human targets in NLOS region, effective time-frequency information of human postures can be extracted. By applying the transfer learning technique with several pre-trained neural networks, all typical human postures can be successfully classified for the NLOS scenario. Experiment results show that the ResNet-50 network with transfer learning technique can provide the highest average classification accuracy of 97.92% for all the typical human postures.

articleTitle: Attention Mechanism-Based DOA Estimation of Closely Spaced Sources for Conformal Array
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Recent developments in electronic countermeasures have raised the demands for direction of arrival (DOA) estimation of closely spaced sources for conformal array. State-of-the-art studies are based on linear or planar array, whose performance would deteriorate sharply for closely spaced sources. Therefore, we design a multi-head attention (MHA) mechanism-based estimator for conformal array, which can estimate DOA in the presence of closely spaced sources. The proposed method consists of MHA and fully connected neural network (FCNN). The MHA is adopted to assign different weights for signal features for improving the efficient use of signal feature information. Then, FCNN is exploit to learn the inverse mapping relationship between the signal reconstruction features and the spatial domain by training. Experimental results verify our inspiration that it not only shows better performance in resolution and accuracy even at lower signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), but also provides great robustness on angle interval and snapshots.

articleTitle: Information Theory-Based Waveform Design for Rician Target Detection with Dual-Function Radar Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: This paper addresses designing waveforms for dual-function radar-communication (DFRC) system based on a multiple-input-multiple-out (MIMO) array. The focus of the system is on detecting a Rician target and communicating with the downlink cellular users simultaneously. We establish two hypotheses (viz., the target is present/absent) and employ the relative entropy between the two distributions associated with the hypotheses as the design metric. We impose the multi-user interference (MUI) energy constraint on the waveforms to guarantee the quality of service of communication. To tackle the non-convex optimization problem, we present a novel alternating direction of method of multipliers (ADMM) algorithm and adopt an efficient minorization-maximization (MM) approach at each iteration. Numerical results are provided to show the effectiveness of the waveforms synthesized by the proposed algorithm for detecting Rician targets and communicating with the downlink cellular users simultaneously.

articleTitle: Sub-Aperture Mosaic Imaging Approach for Automotive Millimeter Wave SAR Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: This paper proposes a polar format algorithm based on the sub-aperture mosaic, which is used to image the squint stripmap automotive millimeter wave radar echo data. By dividing the full aperture of the echo into sub-apertures, imaging the sub-aperture data with the polar format algorithm, and finally mosaicking the sub-images, the algorithm solves the severe problem of two-dimensional coupling in squint imaging of automotive millimeter wave radar. Moreover, the real-time imaging in automotive environment is taken into account when using polar format algorithm to process sub-aperture data. Simulation and processing of measured data demonstrate the effectiveness and real-time performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Power Allocation of MIMO-NOMA in Multi-Beam Space Division Multiple Access for Underwater Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-beamspace division multiple access (MB-SDMA) by utilizing a directional radiation communication beam of the hemispherical LED array, which can solve the problem of network forming for underwater nodes. Meanwhile, a multiple-input multiple-output non-orthogonal multiple access(MIMO-NOMA) technologies for MB-SDMA is constructed. In this system, a multiple beam selection strategy aiming at the maximum receiving beam energy for the different spatial position is proposed. Then, an optimization model is established to make the user nodes satisfy the fairness criterion of maximizing the minimum rate under the constraint of total transmit power, and the non-convex model is solved by using the bisection method and the KKT condition. Finally, the power allocation algorithm to ensure user fairness is proposed in the multi-beam MIMO-NOMA system.The simulation results show that the system reduces inter-beam interference by reducing the number of radio frequency(RF) links, and it can be seen that the throughput of the multi-beam MIMO-NOMA system is higher than that of the traditional OMA system.

articleTitle: Radar-Based Human Behavior Model Construction and Modulation Pattern Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Micro-Doppler features in human radar echoes can be applied for behavior recognition, particularly the detection of abnormal behaviors, which is valuable for reducing casualties in the elderly. This paper proposes a method for constructing human behavior model in order to realize the simulation of human behavior. The method designs the human body as a structure with 17 joints and 16 parts, and the joints where angular rotations occur and the rotation order of the joints are determined according to various behaviors. The rotation matrix is applied to generate the joint coordinates at different moments. This method is used to construct three categories of human behavior models, and the micro-Doppler spectrum of each type of behavior model are obtained using the short-time Fourier transform. Based on micro-Doppler spectrum, the Doppler frequency modulation pattern of various behaviors on radar echoes are summarized in detail.

articleTitle: Research on the Decision-Making Method of Civil Aviation Airport Safety Risk Early Warning Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
