abstract: In order to solve the problems such as inaccurate determination of early warning index weight and difficult judgment of early warning level in the process of civil airport operation safety risk early warning, this paper uses the method of system safety analysis to establish a civil airport operation safety risk early warning index system to discover potential safety risks, and solves the problem of difficult judgment of early warning level through the decision tree algorithm in data mining algorithm. Finally, the feasibility of the early warning method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Improved Near-Field ISAR Imaging Algorithm for Far-Field Radar Cross Section Measurement
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The measurement of radar cross section (RCS) is of great significance to the development and maintenance of large stealth military targets. The traditional test method is based on target imaging. In the near field, the traditional imaging algorithm is no longer effective. An RCS measurement method based on two-dimensional near-field inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) spherical wave imaging algorithm is proposed. The algorithm calculates the “focusing operator” of each pixel in the image, and then reproduces all scattering points of the target by numerical integration. Finally, the RCS of the target is calculated by Geometric Theory of Diffraction (GTD)-based algorithm. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can obtain accurate image of target, and its RCS calculation accuracy is high for low scattering target, and it has high practicability.

articleTitle: Automatic Classification of Textile Fibers and Content Detection Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In order to improve the identification efficiency of textile fibers and obtain the blending ratio of textile fibers, it is urgent to have an accurate and rapid fiber identification method. In this paper, four new fiber features are proposed in terms of fiber feature extraction: average 2D Gabor bidirectional line features, curvature, fitted curvature and segmented chord length angle change. The average diameter, rectangularity, grayscale symbiotic matrix, average 2D Gabor bipolar line, curvature, fitted curvature, and segmented chord length angle variation were extracted for fibers in total 7 Species characteristics are normalized, using decision tree SVM for flax fibers, modal cotton and viscose fibers Cotton is classified and compared with different nuclear functions, and the data shows that the classification accuracy of the Linear nuclear function is better, and the recognition rate of Modal cotton, linen cotton, and viscose cotton can reach 93.4%, 88.6%, 87.7%. Finally, the average diameter-number method is used to complete the fiber blending ratio test.

articleTitle: Single Image Super-Resolution Based on Enhanced Residual Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Vision is an important way for humans to perceive the world around them. It is an urgent need to improve image quality by using image super resolution. Residual network plays an important role in image super resolution because of its powerful feature extraction ability. Only stacking residual network is not enough to extract a large amount of effective information, and at the same time, more training memory is needed. Therefore, this paper designs a single feature extraction module with better performance to enhance the feature extraction ability of the network. In this paper, the Residual Network is mainly improved, and a Single Image Super-Resolution Based on Enhanced Residual Neural Network (ERNN) is proposed based on improved residual module. Compared with other classical lightweight algorithms, the lightweight network with the new residual module as the basic unit has higher reconstruction ability, and can achieve better image super-resolution reconstruction with a small number of parameters. Moreover, a large number of experiments have verified that the proposed ERNN can achieve the trade-off between the number of parameters and performance.

articleTitle: Root-Music Harmonic Analysis Joint Multiple Regression: DOA Estimation Applied to Millimeter Wave FMCW Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: For millimeter wave (MMW)-FMCW radar estimates the direction-of-arrival (DOA) of targets, we present the root-MUSIC harmonic retrieval joint Multiple Regression (RMHRMR) algorithm. First, the target's IF signal is resolved and reconstructed by the root-MUSIC harmonic retrieval method. Then, by considering both the real data and imaginary data, we regard the signal expression of each array sensor as an independent form of multiple regression and further achieve the DOA by iteratively estimating the regression coefficient of the reconstructed target's IF signal from each array sensor one at a time. The simulation demonstrates the superiority of the proposed RMHRMR algorithm. Finally, the effectiveness of the RMHRHR algorithm in actual situation is verified.

articleTitle: Ship Trajectory Prediction Based On ST-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Based on ship trajectory prediction and aiming at the demand of ship trajectory prediction accuracy, this paper carries out the interpolation and clustering of ship trajectory data from the perspective of data, and proposes a long short-term memory model ST-LSTM based on spatiotemporal characteristics from the perspective of prediction. Based on LSTM network, a spatiotemporal gate is added to process the spatiotemporal information of ship movement behavior separately, and the time and space factors of ship navigation are considered, so that the model has spatiotemporal characteristics. The network model is trained by the actual ship navigation data, and the future ship navigation trajectory is predicted. The predicted value of the future trajectory obtained is compared with the actual value of the real ship voyage. The results show that the model prediction trajectory error is small, which verifies the practicality and effectiveness of ST-LSTM in ship trajectory prediction.

articleTitle: Robust Pattern Synthesis Algorithm in Time-Modulated Linear Array with Position Errors
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The time-modulated array has higher flexibility than the traditional antenna array. However, the time-modulated array is sensitive to random errors. In this paper, the time-modulated uniform linear array with element position errors is discussed. Position errors can not only lower the performance of the array but also lift the side-lobe and increase the dynamic range of the side-lobe. Aimed at this issue, a robust pattern synthesis algorithm is proposed, and simulation results are given to illustrate the effectiveness and the robustness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Synchroextracting Transform Based on a Modified S-Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new time-frequency (TF) analysis (TFA) method called synchroextracting modified S-transform (SEMST). The standard S-transform may be unable to balance the time resolution of the lower frequency regions with the frequency resolution of the higher frequency regions. In order to overcome this drawback, a sigmoid function with three parameters has been introduced into the modified S-transform (MST) window function resulting in better adjustment of the TF resolution in different frequency bands. And the values of parameters are selected based on a quantitative measure of time-frequency distributions concentration to provide a highly energy-concentrated time-frequency representation. Then, the operation of synchroextracting which only retains the TF coefficients of the MST most related to signal time-varying features is employed to further enhance the energy concentration of the TF representation. Two synthetic examples are provided to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Median Value Filtering Method for Non-Circular Signal DOA Estimation with Nested Arrays in the Presence of Impulsive Noise Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Direction of arrival (DOA) estimation algorithms in the impulsive noise environment are mostly based on fractional low-order statistics (FLOS), which is not only complicated in calculation, but also poor in adaptable to strong impulsive noise. In order to mitigate the impulsive noise, a new direction finding method-global median value filtering method has recently been proposed, which exploits the characteristic that the impulsive noise appears with randomness. However, this algorithm can not detect more sources than the number of sensors. In this paper, a median filtering method based on non-circular signals is proposed, and it is extended to nested array scenarios, which expands the virtual array aperture and improves the number of estimated sources and DOA estimation performance. Then the traditional second order moment DOA estimation method can be used to process the covariance matrix of the filtered received data. To further reduce the computational complexity of this algorithm, the reduced dimensional MUSIC (RD-MUSIC) method is introduced for DOA estimation. Simulation results show that the method has better DOA estimation performance than existing methods, especially in the strong impulsive noise environment.

articleTitle: OPASTd Based DOA Tracking Algorithm for Unfolded Coprime Linear Arrays
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: As a kind of array with high degree-of-freedom, unfolded coprime linear array (UCLA) shows good performance in direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation, but there is little research on DOA tracking based on it. For this reason, an improved DOA tracking algorithm for UCLA is proposed in this paper. The algorithm updates the signal subspace through the orthonormal projection approximation and subspace tracking of deflation (OPASTd) algorithm, avoiding the computation of covariance matrix and eigenvalue decomposition. In order to avoid the global spectral peak search, the Root-MUSIC algorithm is used to obtain the DOA of the target. Compared with most traditional algorithms, the proposed algorithm has lower complexity and better real-time performance. MATLAB simulation results show that the algorithm has good performance for DOA tracking of dynamic targets, and still has high accuracy under the background of low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). In addition, the angle tracking performance is further improved compared with the algorithm based on the projection approximation and subspace tracking of deflation (PASTd) algorithm.

articleTitle: Graph Diffusion Kernel Minimum Error Entropy with Fiducial Points
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In recent years, graph signal processing has attracted much attention due to its ability to model irregular and interactive data. However, there is no effective method to deal with the modeling nonlinear systems in a non-Gaussian noise environment. To solve this problem, this paper introduces a minimum error entropy with fiducial points (MEEF), which combines the minimum error entropy (MEE) criterion and the maximum correntropy (MC) criterion and exhibits robustness to impulsive and non-Gaussian noise in adaptive filtering. Therefore, a graph diffusion kernel MEEF (GDKMEEF) algorithm is proposed, which demonstrates good performance when the graph signal is disturbed by non-Gaussian noise. Finally, the robustness of the proposed algorithm to non-Gaussian noise and its excellent performance in reconstructing nonlinear signals are verified by nonlinear graph filter identification simulation.

Author Keywords: minimum error entropy with fiducial points

articleTitle: Combined MS and MMSE-Based Noise Power Spectral Density Estimation of Noisy Multi-component Underwater Acoustic Pulse Signal
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Estimating the noise power spectral density (PSD) from the corrupted signal is an essential part of the signal enhancement algorithms. In this paper, a combined noise PSD estimation algorithm based on the minimum statistics (MS) and minimum mean-square error (MMSE) is proposed for the noisy multi-component underwater acoustic pulse signals. And in particular, the pulse signals are composed of continuous wave (CW) signals and linear frequency modulation (LFM) signals. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively track the spectral noise power of the multi-component signal under non-cooperative conditions without prior information. Experimental result based on sea-truth data shows that the proposed method can efficiently enhance the noisy multi-component signal in terms of improving the relative signal-to-noise ratio (SNR).

articleTitle: Hydrometeor Classification for Dual Polarization Weather Radar Based on SE-ResNeXt Combined with SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Aiming at the defect that the traditional fuzzy logic hydrometeor classification algorithm relies too much on expert experience to set parameters, a hydrometeor classification method based on the structure of squeeze-excitation residual neural networks (SE-ResNeXt) combined with support vector machine (SVM) was proposed in this paper. Firstly, the data of four polarization parameters (horizontal reflectivity factor, differential reflectivity, correlation coefficient and differential propagation phase constant) collected by S-band KOHX dual polarization weather radar were stacked into three-dimensional matrix blocks and preprocessed to make the data set required by the model, and we trained the model. Then, according to the classification results of SE-ResNeXt for the target matrix block and combined with SVM classifier, the hydrometeors in the block were classified. The model that can effectively identify four types of hydrometeors and one type of biological echo was built. Finally, the 0.5° elevation scanning data of KOHX radar is tested, and the classification accuracy of the model for target hydrometeor is 95.13%. We also test the model with the scanning data of different elevations and different radar, the result showed good robustness.

articleTitle: Underwater Acoustic Communication Based on OTFS-IM
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Recently, the orthogonal time-frequency space (OTFS) modulation technique has been proposed to provide reliable communication over time-varying channels, combined with the double dispersion characteristics of underwater acoustic channels to improve the BER performance and spectral efficiency of underwater acoustic communication. In this paper, we propose an underwater acoustic communication system combining index modulation with OTFS. This technique uses indexed bits to control the activation of the grid in the delay-Doppler domain, allowing flexible adjustment of the number of silent and activated grids, resulting in a system with better transmission performance. The effectiveness of the method is demonstrated through simulations where the modified scheme obtains better BER performance than the conventional OFDM-IM modulated underwater acoustic communication system.

articleTitle: UAV Formation Trajectory Planning for Reconnaissance and Positioning Missions
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: A formation UAV radar track optimization method is proposed to address the problem of low positioning accuracy caused by the use of pre-defined tracks in traditional UAV formation for joint reconnaissance and positioning missions. The method first calculates the CRLB to characterize the operative reconnaissance positioning performance of the UAV formation, and then constructs a multi-UAV cooperative trajectory planning method that includes threat area avoidance and airborne radar view restriction for the purpose of optimizing the reconnaissance positioning performance, and solves the obtained optimization model using a particle swarm algorithm. The simulation results show that the proposed method significantly improves the reconnaissance and positioning accuracy of formation UAV for multiple targets.

articleTitle: Low-Flying Moving Target Detection and Imaging Algorithm of Spaceborne SAR Based on Two-Dimensional Velocity Search
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Using spaceborne SAR to detect low-flying moving targets is a difficult problem in the application field of SAR. The existence of ground clutter and sea clutter, mutual interference in the detection of slow and high-velocity targets, azimuth Doppler folding of moving targets, range cell migration and other problems lead to serious defocusing of high-speed moving targets, which is difficult to effectively detect in SAR image. Ultimately, these lead to the difficulty of motion parameter estimation and imaging. Therefore, when the traditional SAR imaging algorithm is used to image the moving target of the spaceborne SAR, the target is usually in a defocused state, which leads to the degradation of the detection performance. In this paper, combined with the BP algorithm, a spaceborne SAR moving target detection algorithm based on two-dimensional velocity (range velocity and azimuth velocity) search is designed to match the Doppler parameters. After realizing the ergodic focusing of the moving target at a uniform speed, target detection is followed. Then the detection probability and imaging quality of the moving target can be improved by comparing the associated amplitude values at different search speeds. The simulation results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Optimal Receiver Placement of External Radiation Source UAV Detection System
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle(UAV) detection and positioning systems based on external radiation sources have been more and more widely used in urban security. The positioning accuracy of the UAV can be improved by optimizing the location of the receiving stations. This paper establishes the signal model of the distributed receiving stations, and deduces the Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) of target location estimation in the coherent case. Then the geometric dilution of precision (GDOP) is introduced as an index to evaluate the positioning performance. Aiming at the problem that the external radiation source is arranged in advance and the position is usually irregular in practical applications, we establish an optimization model considering the UAV positioning accuracy and propose a receiver placement algorithm based on iterative convex approximation. The optimization model is approximated with convex optimization in each iteration until the optimal receiving stations placement is searched. Simulation experiments show that the positioning accuracy of the UAV using the proposed receiver placement algorithm is better than that of the symmetrical layout method.

articleTitle: Continuous Gesture Segmentation Method Based on Micro-Doppler Feature Via Millimeter Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Gesture recognition technology via millimeter wave radar is an efficient human-computer interaction (HCI) solution with a more significant environmental adaptive capability compared with optical sensors. Gesture segmentation is an essential step in gesture recognition process, and most of the previous work has focused on segmenting fixed-length discrete gestures, while less research has been done on segmentation algorithm for a continuous sequence of variable-length gestures. A gesture segmentation method for variable-length continuous gesture sequences based on micro-Doppler feature is proposed. Particularly, the Bidirectional One-Sided CFAR Algorithm (BOS-CFAR) which is derived from Constant False Alarm Rate Algorithm (CFAR) is skillfully designed to detect valid gesture frames. Then the valid frames is set as growth points and clustering operation is implemented to obtain the approximate segmentation parts of each gesture. Finally, the gesture domain is fine-tuned according to the maximum and minimum micro-Doppler values of neighborhood to achieve the segmentation task of variable-length continuous gestures with over 96.6% recall and nearly 100% precision of six gestures.

articleTitle: Change Detection Using Unsupervised Sensitivity Disparity Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: At present, algebraic operation methods in the field of change detection still holds the dominant position. However, in the face of disturbance features, due to the characteristics of poor expansibility, the performance of algebraic operation methods varies greatly in different scenes, and cannot meet the requirements of practical application. In this paper we propose a change detection model based on Sensitivity Disparity Networks (SDNs) for performing change detection in Bi-temporal Hyper-spectral images captured by AVIRIS sensor and HYPERION sensor over time. The SNDs consist of two deep learning models, Unchanged Sensitivity Networks (USNet) and Changed Sensitivity Networks (CSNet), they have sensitivity disparity in changed and unchanged pixels, and thus to generate effective argument region. Next, we re-evaluate the change probability of argument region, and merge the change result of the argument region with that by one of the SDNs. The detected Binary Change Map (BCM) of the scheme is thus obtained. To train and evaluate the proposed schema we employ two Bi-temporal Hyper-spectral image datasets which contain challenging pseudo-changed features (PCFs) and pseudo-invariant features (PIFs) cause by various external interference factors. The proposed schema outperforms the existing state-of-the-art algorithms on tested datasets. Experimental results show that the proposed schema has good universality and adaptability.

articleTitle: Research on State Recognition of Rubik's Cube Based on Monocular Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Object state acquisition is one of the most critical parts of the industrial automated system. To ensure the acquisition accuracy of the object states, the system usually adopts the method of adding enough sensors, which makes the system more complicated. Taking the state recognition of Rubik's Cube as an example, Huawei Smart Cube utilizes six sensors to fetch state information. In this paper, we propose a different method that only uses a single sensor to get the object states. The monocular camera is used to collect the color information and geometric outline information of the target Rubik's Cube. The KNN algorithm is applied to maximally distinguish various colors, especially yellow, orange, and red, to ensure acceptable color recognition accuracy. The geometric relationship between the position coordinates of adjacent blocks is utilized to confirm whether the current Rubik's Cube is in a self-rotation state or a recognition state. That helps to solve the key state recognition problem. In the experiment, an AR tag is utilized to indicate the user to operate the Rubik's Cube based on the Kociemba algorithm. It has been proved by experiments that our method can reach similar results to the multi-sensors obtained. It shows that the deep utilization of the single sensor information can also obtain the same results generated by multi-sensor information joint processing.

articleTitle: Signatures of Moving Target in Spotlight SAR Imagery
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The synthetic aperture radar (SAR) signatures of moving target are the basis of ground moving target detection imaging and relocation. However, previous studies are mainly based on the 2-D separable SAR processing, and little work has been done to investigate the signatures of moving target after the application of a particular fine resolution SAR image formation algorithm. In this paper, we derive the image spectrum of the moving target after representative fine resolution SAR image formation algorithm, i.e., the polar format algorithm (PFA), respectively. Based on the spectrum derived, the SAR signatures of moving targets are analyzed in detail, including the geometric displacement, and the defocusing effect. Finally the analytical results are verified via simulation data processing.

articleTitle: Software Safety Level Comprehensive Assessment Approach Based on the Multidimensional System Risk Index
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The accuracy software safety level assessment can ensure the various software obtain the reasonable resource allocation. Most existing software safety level assessment approaches only consider the influence of the system hazards and don't consider the hazard occurrence probability level, the probability level that the system in the hazard conditions, and the other important occurrence factors. Thus these approaches can't assess the system safety level accurately. To solve this problem, a new software safety level comprehensive assessment approach is proposed in this paper based on the multidimensional system risk index. This method first determines four important influence factors of the software safety level according to the related standards, namely the hazard influence level ‘C’, the probability level ‘F’ that the system in the hazard condition, the probability level ‘P’ that system fails to control the hazard, and the hazard occurrence probability level ‘W’. Then, we propose the comprehensive assessment method of the system risk index with the four factors. Finally, the application results show that the proposed approach are more comprehensive and extensive, and has better practicability, effectiveness, and feasibility.

articleTitle: PolSAR Image Classification Via a Novel Selective Kernel Encoder-Decoder Fully Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In recent years, convolutional neural networks (CNN) have made significant advances in polarimetric synthetic aperture radar (PolSAR) image classification. However, the current CNN-based PolSAR classifiers are patch-wise frameworks. The images need to be divided into overlapping patches, which have the disadvantage of repeated calculation. Additionally, the receptive field in CNN-based methods has fixed sizes, which restricts feature extraction capability. In this paper, an attention-based selective kernel encoder-decoder fully convolutional network (SK-EDNet) is introduced to PolSAR classification. Compared to CNN-based methods, the encoder-decoder fully convolutional network (EDNet) can use arbitrary-size images as input and output the whole image classification results. Meanwhile, it is utilized to extract global spatial information, which can improve the performance of classification. Besides, a selective kernel module is added to the EDNet, in which softmax attention is used to fuse several branches with different receptive field sizes. Hence, the selective kernel module can capture features with different scales and improve classification performance. The experiment results demonstrate that the SK-EDNet can obtain superior performance compared with CNN-based and traditional fully convolutional network methods.

articleTitle: A Stereovision EEG Channel Selection Method Based on Cross Increment Entropy Maximization
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) has been widely used in the research on stereo vision because it is a convenient neuroimaging technology. However, the multi-channel EEG signals make laboratory operations complicated, and the data analysis is also easily affected by redundant channels. Therefore, we proposed a method called Cross Increment Entropy Maximization (CIEM) for the selection of EEG channels. Results showed that the channels related to stereoscopic vision could be effectively preserved by CIEM. This method is significant for the removal of the interference of redundant channels and the facilitation of experimental process.

articleTitle: Cooperative Spectrum Sensing Based on Riemann Distance of Subband Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Spectrum sensing is the core of cognitive radio (CR) technology. In this paper, we propose a cooperative spectrum sensing algorithm based on the Riemann distance of subband signals. By mapping the covariance matrices of receiving signal to the points on the manifold, the spectrum sensing problem is transformed into a geometric problem on the manifold. The difference between the Riemann distance and the Euclidean distance applied to spectrum sensing is analyzed theoretically. Considering that the signal has different characteristics at different frequencies, the DFT modulation filter bank is used to decompose the signal, and then the sub-signals are processed separately. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Multi-view SAR Target Recognition Using Bidirectional Conv-LSTM Network
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Deep neural networks are widely used in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) automatic target recognition (ATR) due to their excellent performance. The imaging mechanism of SAR images differs from that of optical images in that SAR images are highly angle sensitive. However, current SAR ATR methods based on deep learning frameworks generally lack the use of spatial correlation information between multi-view SAR images. In this paper, we propose a multi-view SAR image recognition method based on a bidirectional convolutional long and short term memory (Conv-LSTM) network. Firstly, we use a Log-Gabor filter to extract angle-stable monogenic features to reduce inter-class differences. Secondly, feature dimensionality reduction is performed using a multilayer perceptron (MLP) network. Finally, a bidirectional LSTM network is used to integrate the SoftMax classifier for target recognition. The experimental results on the MSTAR dataset and the self-made dataset show that the average recognition accuracy of our proposed method can reach more than 99%. The results of our method outperform other existing methods, indicating the effectiveness and application potential of our algorithm.

articleTitle: Coherent Integration of High-Speed Maneuvering Targets Based on KT-SWVD
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Coherent integration is one of most important techniques to improve radar detection performance of high-speed maneuvering targets. The traditional coherent integration algorithms have the problem of high time complexity. And for high-speed maneuvering targets, long-time coherent integration will produce the problems of Doppler spread and range walking. In order to solve the problems, this paper proposes the Keystone Transform-Second order Wigner-Ville Distribution (KT-SWVD) algorithm. Firstly, the keystone transform is used to correct the range walk of the target echo. Then, according to the SWVD algorithm, the matrix is constructed to transform the signal to the slow time domain-delay time domain plane. After superposition and integration along the slow time dimension, the motion parameters of the target are extracted, and the compensation factor is constructed according to the estimated motion parameters to complete the compensation of Doppler spread. The KT-SWVD algorithm is simulated and compared with traditional algorithms such as Generalized Radon Fourier Transform (GRFT). The simulation results show that KT-SWVD algorithm can reduce the complexity of the algorithm and can effectively estimate the motion parameters of the target

articleTitle: A Low Complexity Algorithm of Beamforming Optimization for IRS-Assisted MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In order to provide secure, efficiency and high- quality mobile wireless communication with limited wireless resources and improve network spectral efficiency. In this paper, we consider an intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) assisted point- to-point multi-input multi-output (MIMO) communication system. According to the sum-path-gain maximization criteria, under the single-mode constraints of the phase shift vector and the maximum transmitting power constraints of the transmitting side, the spectral efficiency of the system is maximized. The linear alternating direction multiplier (LADMM) algorithm is used to optimize the phase shift of the IRS and the precoding matrix of the transmitter. By Taylor expansion of the objective function, the inverse operation of matrix in iterations is avoided. The results show that this method reduces the computational complexity, higher spectral efficiency can be achieved, the spectral efficiency and performance of the system have been further improved.

articleTitle: LSTM-Based Learning Control for Biomimetic Robotic Fish Swimming
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: To precisely manage the location and trajectory of a biomimetic robotic fish moving in water, it is crucial to comprehend its pressure and derive the related dynamic equation. In the process of dynamic modeling, the movement of robotic fish is affected by its shape, mechanical structure, and complex fluid force, making it difficult to precisely regulate the robotic fish's movement. Consequently, this article employs an LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) neural network to discover the variations in robotic fish joint angles. Meanwhile, simulations and experiments of LSTM-controlled bionic robot fish swimming straight and turning are presented. These simulated and experimental results validate the method's efficiency.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of Changchun University Virtual History Museum Roaming Interactive System
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The establishment of a virtual campus is a good opportunity to guide and promote the modernization of college education. With the development of the third-generation Internet technology, virtual reality technology is emerging. The paper takes the Changchun University History Museum as the background. This paper discusses the application of virtual technology in the construction of virtual campus museum system, from the aspects of the meaning of virtual school history museum, module design, development process and support operation mode. In the end, it is concluded that the virtual campus history museum is beneficial to the university humanities and moral education.

articleTitle: Mechanism Analysis of Coherent Detectors for Radar Targets in Compound-Gaussian Sea Clutter
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Coherent detectors are important means for maritime radar to suppress sea clutter and detect targets, so in this paper we focus on analyzing the working mechanism of different coherent detectors for radar targets in compound-Gaussian sea clutter. The commonly-used clutter distribution models and the corresponding coherent detectors are reviewed firstly. Then similarities and differences of coherent detectors and the reasons for them are given. Finally, the performance superiority of detectors is investigated by analyzing the statistical behavior of test statistics.

articleTitle: Wideband Beamforming Method for Uniform Circular Array Based on Empirical Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The abstract summarizes key findings in the paper. According to the characteristics of underwater acoustic environment and underwater acoustic signals, a wideband beamforming method of uniform circular array based on empirical mode decomposition is proposed. The performance of traditional adaptive beamforming methods is affected when steering vector of signal is mismatch and the resolution of the conventional beamforming is limited by the “Rayleigh limit”. In this method, EMD is introduced into solve the above problems, and a new data matrix in modal domain is constructed. Array beamforming in modal domain can improve the detection effect of weak targets in the interference environment. Experimental data processing results show that the proposed method can obtain the range and azimuth parameters of the signals effectively and performs superior interference suppression ability.

articleTitle: Application of BBPSO-ABC Optimization Algorithm in Estimation of Dredging Volume of Trailing Suction Hopper Dredger
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Since the settlement process of the dredger is a slow and dynamic process, the loading operation status of the dredger cannot be obtained in real time by the sensor. Understanding the internal loading process of the trailing suction hopper dredger (TSHD) is crucial to improve the efficiency of dredging and carry out green dredging. Based on the dynamic deposition model of the TSHD, this paper proposes a new algorithm (BBPSO-ABC), which combines the backbone particle swarm (BBPSO) and artificial bee swarm (ABC), and uses particle search method to find new particles in the follow-up and reconnaissance stages of the artificial bee swarm algorithm introduced into the backbone particle swarm. The results demonstrate that the BBPSO-ABC optimized filter algorithm is more accurate and close to the true value in the state estimate of the loading process when compared to the three current standard improved particle swarm optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Collaborative Power Allocation and Waveform Selection Strategy for Multi-Target Tracking in Airborne Radar System
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In this paper, a collaborative power allocation and waveform selection strategy (CPA-WS) is developed for multi-target tracking (MTT) in airborne radar system. The mechanism of the proposed CPA-WS strategy is to collaboratively coordinate the velocity, heading angle, transmit power, waveform pulselength and bandwidth of the airborne radar, in order to achieve accurate target position estimation under the constraints of maneuverability performance and system resource budgets. The Bayesian Cramer-Rao lower bound (BCRLB) incorporating the above variables is derived to characterize the target tracking accuracy. Since the above parameters are coupled in the objective function, the resulting optimization problem is nonlinear and nonconvex, which is difficult to solve directly. Combined with cyclic minimization approach, an effective partition-based four-step method is proposed to solve the resulting problem. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed CPA-WS strategy achieves the best MTT performance compared with other existing algorithms.

Author Keywords: collaborative power allocation and waveform selection (CPA-WS)

articleTitle: Improved CFAR Method Based on Sea Clutter Scene Discrimination
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: When shore-based radar detects the sea, sea clutter is affected by many factors, which leads to its complexity and variability. The clutter data of near-shore sea area is more complex than that of long-distance sea area. Based on this, through the scene discrimination of complex marine environment, the sea scene is divided into multiple regions, and then the amplitude probability distribution type of sea clutter in each region is judged. Different constant false alarm detectors are used for different distribution types to detect targets and improve performance.The results show that the detection performance of multiple CFAR detectors is better than that of single CFAR detector according to the scene discrimination results, and the detection performance of CFAR is improved from the perspective of background.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Method of Ship Equipment Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The traditional fault diagnosis method of ship power equipment has some problems, such as highly dependent on expert experience and low versatility. Therefore, an intelligent diagnosis method based on the deep convolutional neural network was proposed in this paper. In view of the interference from working environment of the ship equipment and the signal interference caused by variable load, the network depth and convolution kernel size are improved based on the one-dimensional CNN model, the FRN-DCNN model is proposed. To further improve the domain adaptive ability of convolutional neural network, the residual model was introduced and the Res14-DCNN diagnosis model based on the residual model was proposed. Experiments show that Res14-DCNN model has high noise resistance and variable load adaptability, which indicates that increasing the number of layers of neural network and introducing residual module can effectively improve the domain adaptability of deep convolution neural network.

articleTitle: Ground Surveillance Radar Target Classification Based on 2D Selective CA CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In this paper, a new 2D convolutional neural networks (CNN) model is proposed for classifying targets detected by low-resolution ground surveillance radar. The targets echoes can be disposed in different domains to obtain their unique features which can be used in classification. Using the proposed network for radar target classification consists of two steps, using Toeplitz matrix to reconstruct original 1D signal to 2D and constructing the Selective CA (coordinate attention) model for target classification. In first step, Toeplitz matrix is made use of reconstructing Radar signal to build 2D data without changing the characteristic distribution of the signal, which makes it possible to train radar signal with 2D CNN. In second step, we construct the 2D Selective CA model. Each block of the model we propose applies the CA to different receptive fields for feature fusion. The residual structure is also included, which can make the information spread more smoothly in the network and effectively solve the problem of vanishing/exploding gradients int the back propagation process. The model was trained and tested on actual collected database containing human and car, which finally achieve 99.2% accuracy on the original frequency domain test set and 97.89% accuracy on the original time domain test set.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of COVID-19 from Chest CT Images Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Novel coronavirus disease (COVID-19) is an extremely contagious and quickly spreading coronavirus infestation, it was recognized in December 2019 and has posed critical challenges for the public health, research, and medical communities. In the fight against this novel disease, there is a pressing need for rapid and effective screening tools to identify patients infected with COVID-19, and to this end Computed Tomography imaging has been proposed as one of the key screening methods. In this paper, CT image dataset is preprocessed to get probable COVID-19 CT images which are associated with COVID-19 pneumonia (so-called prob-CT). Based on it, a diagnostic method for CT chest images using deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) models is presented. Here the data includes hundreds of images obtained by one computed tomography and is fed into the proposed model for deep feature extractions. We analyse and evaluate the performance of the model in COVID-19 diagnosis. The result obtained by semiquantitative analysis of preferred measures shows that the proposed model performs well with accuracy (92.1%) and sensitivity (93.6%).

articleTitle: Registration for SAR Image Based on Phase Congruency
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Image registration is essential for many platforms such as satellites and missiles to improve positioning accuracy. For Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) image registration, robust RIFT based on Radiation-Variation Insensitive Feature Transform (RIFT) is proposed to improve its robustness and reduce time consumption. RIFT originally use fast sample consensus (FSC) to remove outliers, which adds to its weakness for images with noise or local geometrical deformation. To address this problem, prior knowledge from the inertial navigation system is used to eliminate several outliers before feature matching. In the experiments, the algorithm is tested on two SAR image data sets, and the results show that the proposed algorithm improves registration accuracy significantly with relatively very low time consumption.

articleTitle: Multimodal Semantic Fusion for Vehicle Driving Based on Residual Connections and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Cameras and 3DLidar are indispensable sensors in vehicle driving, in which cameras can provide rich color and texture information, and 3DLidar can capture environmental information with higher precision and longer distances, especially in depth measurement. Sensors can complement each other in the detection of the environment, so how to efficiently fuse the two modal information has become a research hotspot. In this paper, a module based on residual network and attention mechanism is designed to fuse the features of the dual-stream network, enhance the deep features through the direct connection, and change the feature combination form to achieve a better road environment semantic segmentation effect.

articleTitle: Angle Estimation for Bistatic MIMO Radar with Prior Range-Sum Information
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In this paper, a novel direction-of-departure (DOD) and direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation method is proposed for bistatic multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar with prior range-sum information. In traditional bistatic MIMO radar angle estimation, the estimation of DOA and DOD is identified through two-dimensional (2D) searching. Different from the traditional methods, the angle information of target is estimated with prior knowledge of the transmitter-target-receiver range-sum, which improves the estimation accuracy. The relationship between DOD and DOA is derived by using the range-sum information. Consequently, once the corresponding range-sum of target is identified, the corresponding mapping relationship between DOD and DOA is obtained. In this case, 2D searching procedure is not required anymore resulting in greatly reducing the computational complexity. The Cramer Rao bound of the proposed signal model is derived to prove that the lower limit of angle estimation accuracy is lower than that of the traditional signal model. The robustness and effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated via simulation results.

articleTitle: The Computational Complexity Reduced Effectively in the Channel Estimation Process
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: A fast algorithm for solving Toeplitz matrix equation is applied to wireless communication to estimate channel impulse response in this paper. The sequence with ideal cyclic autocorrelation property is used as the basic sequence, and then the training sequence is constructed by cyclic expansion. Therefore, the equation that needs to be solved in the channel estimation process can become a Toeplitz matrix equation, and then the Toeplitz matrix equation can be solved by a fast algorithm to estimate the channel impulse response. It has shown in the simulation results that the computational complexity in the channel estimation process can be effectively reduced and the channel estimation result is accurate.

articleTitle: Transmit Beampattern Synthesis for RIS-Aided Radar via Sidelobe Level Minimization
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) has been introduced into radar systems to generate an extra path from the transceiver to the target by artificially reflecting radar signals, and thus provides additional degrees-of-freedom to enhance the performance. This paper studies the beampattern synthesis for a RIS-aided radar by minimizing the peak sidelobe level and the mismatch error between the mainlobe beampattern and the desired one. The proposed beampattern synthesis is described as a nonconvex constrained optimization problem to jointly design the digital beamforming of the radar transmitter and the passive beamforming of the RIS. To solve the problem, the auxiliary variables are first introduced to simplify the nonconvex constraints. Then all variables are alternatively optimized by using the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), in which the active beamforming is provided by its close-form feasible solution and the passive beamforming is solved by the Riemannian manifold optimization. Numerical results show that the proposed RIS-aided radar can supply a significantly lower sidelobe level than typical monostatic radars.

articleTitle: A LoRa Modulation-Based System Capacity Enhancement Method
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: This paper proposes a LoRa (Long Range) scheme based on improved index modulation to address the problems of inadequate system capacity, low data rate and poor Bit Error Ratio (BER) performance of index modulation-based LoRa communication systems. The scheme firstly embeds one bit in the conventional LoRa symbol to achieve slope shift keying modulation, then transmits the index combination of the slope shift keying symbol based on the index set obtained through the index mapper, and finally the optimal non-coherent detection algorithm at the receiver is given to realize the system capacity enhancement scheme. Simulation results show that the spectral efficiency, data rate and BER performance of the proposed scheme are better than the existing index-modulated LoRa scheme under the constant modulation bandwidth.

articleTitle: Amplitude Mutual Information-Based Radar Waveform Design for Integrated Radar and Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The integrated radar and communication systems can effectively solve the problem of lack of spectrum resources, which is a typical application of spectrum sharing technology. This paper considers the problem of amplitude mutual information-based radar waveform design for the integrated radar and communication systems in the same frequency band. The joint radar-communication mutual information (MI) is proposed to be utilized as the integrated performance metric for integrated systems. The joint radar-communication MI is the sum of radar amplitude MI and conditional communication MI with knowing radar channels. Based on this model, the MI and Neyman-Pearson (NP) criteria are considered to optimize the multi-carrier radar waveform under total transmit power and channel capacity constraints. We employ the waveform design method to investigate the performance of target detection. Numerical results demonstrate that the performance of target detection can be efficiently improved by exploiting the amplitude MI-based and NP-based criteria. It is also shown that the performance of MI-based method tends to be the same as MI-based method in high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). The scattered part of the communication signal at the target can improve the target detection probability by 11.06% to 34.71%.

articleTitle: Transmit Beamforming for Dual-Function Radar- Communication System Based on FDA
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Dual-function radar-communication (DFRC) methods employed phased array and multiple-input multiple- output (MIMO) systems are “point-to-line”. The enemy hidden in coverage can intercept the transmit signals leading to poor confidentiality. Frequency diversity array (FDA) can provide an angle-time-dependent transmit steering vector by introducing a stepping frequency increment among each array element. This paper proposes an anti-interception DFRC system based on FDA transmit beamforming. The proposed system adopts a sub-pulse transmit mode to realize a “point-to-point” detection and communication. The information symbols are embedded into the transmit beampattern by beam level control and orthogonal waveform transmission. The receiver can obtain the original information by detecting the received signal amplitude in multiple channels. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed system can perform “point-to-point” detection and communication capability with a low bit error rate and high confidentiality.

articleTitle: Structural Tensor Nonlinear Complex Diffusion-Based Method for Sonar Image Denoising
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: This paper presents a sonar image denoising method based on structural tensor and nonlinear complex diffusion (STNCD). The complex diffusion in STNCD utilizes the imaginary value generated by the diffusion process as the directional structure indicator, then controls the diffusion coefficient by introducing the eigenvalue of the structural tensor and the spatial variation structure factor related to the eigenvector. As a result, the complex value of STNCD ensures that the phase information of the image is preserved during the noise suppression process. Furthermore, we make use of the difference between the principal eigenvectors of the structural tensor to describe the local coherence of the features, and then solve the problem that the phase angle cannot be accurately estimated when constructing the structural tensor. Experimental results show that STNCD not only suppresses sonar image noise but also enhances the signal of image edge, which has a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Detection of Human Breathing behind L-Shaped Corner by Using mmWave FMCW Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Radar detection of human vital signs in the non-line-of-sight (NLOS) region suffers from serious multipath effects. A scheme for detecting human breathing in the NLOS region behind an L-shaped corner by using millimeter-wave (mmWave) frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar is proposed. Based on an on-site survey of the NLOS region with a human in it, radar echoes can be analyzed to establish the multipath models of radar signal propagation and localize the human target in the NLOS region. After preprocessing and denoising of the radar echoes, the human breathing signal can be extracted accurately.

articleTitle: Human 3D Avatar Modeling with Implicit Neural Representation: A Brief Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: A human 3D avatar is one of the important elements in the metaverse, and the modeling effect directly affects people's visual experience. However, the human body has a complex topology and diverse details, so it is often expensive, time-consuming, and laborious to build a satisfactory model. Recent studies have proposed a novel method, implicit neural representation, which is a continuous representation method and can describe objects with arbitrary topology at arbitrary resolution. Researchers applied implicit neural representation to human 3D avatar modeling and obtained more excellent results than traditional methods. This paper comprehensively reviews the application of implicit neural representation in human body modeling. First, we introduce three implicit representations of occupancy field, SDF, and NeRF, and make a classification of the literature investigated in this paper. Then the application of implicit modeling methods in the body, hand, and head are compared and analyzed respectively. Finally, we point out the shortcomings of current work and provide available suggestions for researchers.

articleTitle: Power Allocation for Non-Coherent Multi-Carrier FSK Underwater Acoustic Communication Systems with Uneven Transmission Source Level
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Non-coherent multi-carrier Frequency Shift Keying (FSK) is widely used in underwater acoustic communication systems due to its high reliability, low receiving complexity, and less susceptibility to channel conditions. In practical underwater acoustic communication systems, due to the wide band nature of the signal, the overall transmitting source level is usually not flat. Targeting at this issue, this paper proposes power allocation methods based on genetic algorithm and adaptive greedy algorithm, which maximize channel capacity and system robustness. Results based on simulated and pool experimental channels show that our methods can achieve higher channel capacity and lower bit error rate than power averaging scheme, therefore better system performance can be obtained.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Exposure Aware RSMA for Multiuser Massive MIMO Uplink
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: This paper investigates the rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) transmission design for multiuser multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) uplink with EM exposure constraints. Specifically, the transmit covariance matrices and decoding order are optimized at the users and BS, respectively, via utilizing statistical channel state information (CSI) to maximize the energy efficiency (EE). The problem is formulated as non-convex mixed integer program, which is divided into the equivalent two subproblems. We first handle the inner problem by adopting the minorization-maximization (MM) and Dinkelbachs methods. Then, a modified water-filling scheme is proposed to obtain the transmit covariance matrices with fixed decoding permutation. For the outer problem, a greedy approach is proposed to obtain the decoding permutation. Numerical results verify the effectiveness of the proposed EM exposure aware EE maximization scheme for uplink RSMA.

articleTitle: Evaluating Immersive Animation Authoring in an Industrial VR Training Context
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: An important aspect of a Virtual Reality (VR) training application is animation, as animations can be used to present behavior and intent, and make the virtual space feel more alive and immersive. In existing VR applications and in the literature, several animation authoring solutions exist that enable users to create animations directly in VR. These solutions, however, typically aim to recreate the animation tools found in traditional 3D animation software, which are complex and known for their steep learning curves. For an industrial subject matter expert creating a virtual training space, an immersive animation tool should require little to no time to learn while still enabling users to solve common animation tasks such as simple 3D object animation. Few such tools exist, and little research has been done on animation authoring in an industrial VR context. In this paper, we present a mixed methods user study with seven participants including industrial subject matter experts. The participants were asked to complete three animation tasks using an immersive animation authoring tool developed for this study, followed by post-task questionnaires and a semi-structured expert interview. Thematic analysis of the interview and observation data, supported by the subjective measurements, revealed that industrial end users without animation experience found the animation tool both intuitive and easy to learn. The analysis also gave insights into the major challenges faced by non-animators when using the tool as well as possible solutions.

articleTitle: Satellite Video Stabilization Method Based on Global Motion Consistency
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: As a new earth observation technology, video satellite is of great significance for extracting and analyzing large-scale and deep-level dynamic information. Satellite video data will gradually become one of the important data sources for intelligent surveying and mapping application services. However, video satellites have problems such as random jitter, which leads to unstable video, and low matching accuracy between frames due to satellite video content containing moving objects. In this paper, a satellite video stabilization method based on global motion consistency constraints is proposed. The method first uses the lightweight ORB algorithm to extract and describe the feature points of each video frame and perform frame-by-frame matching. Secondly, global motion consistency is used to eliminate mismatch points and imprecise matching points. Then, the affine transformation matrix is obtained and linearized according to the matching point pairs. Finally, the linearized affine transformation matrix is used to resample frame by frame to obtain a stable video. To verify the effectiveness of the method in this paper, the video data of SkySat-1, Jilin-1 and Zhuhai-1 are selected for experiments. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can overcome the inter-frame dynamic target interference and improve the inter-frame matching accuracy, to efficiently achieve stable satellite video output.

articleTitle: Functional-Penetrated Interactive System Towards Virtual-Real Fusion Environments
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Current mixed reality technology cannot completely map the information in the physical world to the virtual environment, and the user must take off the head-mounted display to deal with the affairs in the real environment when using the mixed reality system. This greatly reduces the immersion created by the virtual reality system, and also reduces work efficiency. In order to realize the user's direct interaction with the physical world in the virtual environment without destroying the immersion of the virtual reality system, this paper proposes a functional-penetrated interactive system towards the virtual-real fusion environment, which extracts the visual information of objects from the real scene captured by the RGB camera through deep neural networks, completes virtual-real registration and presents it in real time in the virtual environment, and finally enables the user to complete the manipulation of the physical objects in the virtual environment. In addition, the system also allows the user to dynamically adjust the virtual-real fusion ratio according to the user's needs, which achieves a balance between the immersion of the virtual-real fusion environment and the interaction efficiency of the system. Experimental results show that the system can provide users with more realistic physical feedback, with higher interaction freedom and universality.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Fish Image Recognition System Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems existing in the traditional artificial recognition methods, a design method of fish image recognition system based on transfer learning is proposed to realize the intelligent recognition of Marine fish images. Firstly, the system selects five basic deep learning pre-training models as BaseNet, and carried out experiments by using data image preprocessing, network model structure fine-tuning, training parameters fine-tuning and other methods. Secondly, in order to better present the recognition results, the migration FAST-SCNN pre-training model is used to extract the boundary contour features, so that the system can not only recognize the categories of fish images, but also segment the boundary contour of fish images. The front-end of the system uses Vue.js framework for page building, and the back-end uses the Flask framework based on Python language for deployment. By calling the trained model files such as recognition and segmentation, functions such as fish recognition, contour prediction and page presentation are realized. Finally, experiments are carried on the preprocessed F4K dataset, and the experimental results show that the comprehensive performance of migrated InceptionV3 method is the best, and its recognition accuracy is 99.49%. Compared with T-inceptionV3 method, the recognition accuracy is improved by 5.16%. The proposed design and implementation method of the system provides a feasible idea for the application of fish image recognition technology in the web, which can be used for reference by Marine researchers and developers.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Algorithm of Low-Resolution Radar Target Recognition Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Radar target recognition is an important research direction in the field of radar information processing. Low resolution radar ground target classification and recognition still has broad application prospects in modern military and civil fields. Convolutional neural network (CNN) has attracted more and more attention in the field of radar automatic target recognition, because it does not need Feature Engineering and has superior classification performance. The optimization algorithm of neural network is proposed, and the effects of different network structures on the recognition effect are compared, in this paper. The results show that the multi-scale wide residual network multi-target classification algorithm based on optimized auto-encoder has better recognition effect in low resolution radar target recognition.

articleTitle: SSIGAN: Semantic Segmentation via Improved Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Nowadays, although conditional convolutional neural networks have applied to semantic segmentation, their loss function needs to be carefully designed. We propose an improved generative adversarial network including a generator network and a discriminator network for semantic segmentation. In some blocks, we substitute 3×1 and 1×3 factorized convolution for 3×3 convolution to make full use of transverse and longitudinal information. We concat the original image with the output of the generator as the input of the discriminator network to improve the discriminant ability. As a result, our model achieves 69.6% mean intersection over union (mIoU) on the Cityscapes test set. Our experiments exhibit that adversarial training approach leads to improved accuracy on the Cityscapes, Camvid, Kitti and Gatech dataset in road scene.

articleTitle: Non-Linear Filtering with Multivariable Skew T Noises
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Compared with the Gaussian noise, the heavy tailed and skew Non-Gaussian noise fit the noise characteristics better in the real environment; Similarly, most of the systems in real-world scene are nonlinear. Assuming that the process noise and measurement noise which obey multivariable Skew T distribution, we combine the heavy tailed and skew Non-Gaussian noise with nonlinear system, and develop a variational Bayesian extended Kalman filtering in this paper, which is explained in detail later. then verify the performance of the algorithm from multiple perspectives of simulation data, including: Setting l00s and 300s simulation duration respectively to verify the tracking accuracy and stability of the algorithm; The comparison with the extended Kalman filter shows that the accuracy of this algorithm is higher than that of the former; The tracking accuracy of the algorithm can be improved by increasing the number of iterations. Finally, we summarize the advantages and disadvantages of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Integrated Waveform Design of Radar and Communication Systems for the Single Transmitter Multiple Receivers System
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Compared with a monostatic radar system, a Single Transmitter Multiple Receivers (STMR) system has the advantages of high detection accuracy, long detection distance, and good Low Probability of Intercept (LPI) performance. The integrated radar and communication system has been a research hotspot because it can significantly reduce system volume and power consumption. To realize the radar and communication integration of the STMR system, an integrated waveform design method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the necessary source information for successfully cooperative detection is designed and preprocessing is applied to improve communication effectiveness and reliability. Secondly, the integrated waveform based on the spread spectrum technique and Minimum Shift Keying (MSK) modulation is designed to enable the signal to have the anti-interference and anti-intercept ability, which is called the DSSS-FH-MSK signal. The coded sequence goes through the Direct Sequence Spread Spectrum (DSSS), and the sequence after spreading spectrum is modulated by MSK, then the frequency of the carrier hops randomly by using the Hopping Frequency (HF) technique. Simulation results indicate that the DSSS-FH-MSK signal has a thumbtack type Cross Ambiguity Function (CAF) which means it has good estimation performance in the STMR system. Additionally, LPI evaluation methods are employed to verify that the designed signal has excellent LPI performance.

articleTitle: Across-scale Local Difference L1-norm Principal Component Analysis Network for Facial Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Facial expression recognition has long been a research hotspot in the fields of artificial intelligence and computer vision due to its various applications. In this paper, we proposed a novel method named across-scale local difference L1-norm principal component analysis network (ALDL1-PCANet) to extract powerful and discriminative expression features. Based on the idea of PCANet model, we construct a multiscale space to calculate across-scale local differences of expression images to obtain the holist and local information. Then, we implement L1-norm PCA to learn the convolution filters of two stages from the across-scale local differences. Afterwards, we encode the output images by binary hash and concatenate all the block-wise histograms to form expression features. Finally, we employ support vector machine (SVM) with linear kernel for classification. Extensive experiments are conducted on both controlled and uncontrolled expression databases, including CK+, JAFFE, ISED and BAUM-2i. Experimental results demonstrate our proposed method outperforms the most of existing methods by effectively extracting powerful and discriminative features from both acted and spontaneous expressions.

articleTitle: An Improved Interpolation Algorithm for the Damped Signal Based on Hann Window
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Up to date, numerous studies for parameter estimation have been carried out for the tapered signals. This paper proposes a novel interpolation algorithm with the Hann window to obtain the estimations of the frequency and damping factor. Firstly, the interpolation algorithm with the Hann window is derived, and a criterion for determining the root related to the frequency and damping factor estimations is analyzed in detail. Secondly, the estimation variances are theoretically analyzed, and verified by simulations. Comparative simulations are performed to show the capabilities against the white Gaussian noise. Then, the proposed interpolation algorithm is applied to estimate the instantaneous angular speed (IAS) from a practical vibration signal. Finally, the IAS estimation is further applied to the fault diagnosis of bearing, and the results show that it can recognize the fault accurately. Therefore, the improved interpolation algorithm with the Hann window has obvious advantages in the parameter estimation.

articleTitle: Improved Tensor-Based Near-Field Target Localization Method in Bistatic MIMO Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In this paper, we focus on the near-field multitarget localization problem implemented on a bistatic MIMO radar. Difference from the conventional matrix-based methods like Multiple Signal Classification (MUSIC), we establish the signal model with a tensor-based model and solve the target parameters with the power of tensor analysis and numerical optimization methods. The proposed method provides relatively good performance compared to conventional matrix-based methods, both in estimation accuracy and computation cost. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and good performance of the proposed method, and it showcases its potential application value in various engineering scenarios.

articleTitle: A Sparse Array DOA Estimation Approach Based on Matrix Completion
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of direction of arrival (DOA) estimation for sparse array, this paper applies low-rank matrix completion theory to DOA estimation and proposes an improved matrix completion model and optimization solution. The proposed method utilizes the Hermitian and Toeplitz structural information of the observation matrix as a priori information. We split the augmented Lagrangian function and minimize one of the subproblems by Dykstra alternating projection which makes the completion matrices keep the Toeplitz structure and accomplishes the denoising of the known data. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively realize the reconstruction of sparse array, the performance of DOA estimation is excellent, and it can be applied to coherent sources.

articleTitle: A VQ-VAE Based Recognition Algorithm for Terahertz Security Inspection Images
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: Terahertz imaging technology has been used in the field of security inspection due to its excellent perspective ability. However, the terahertz security inspection images have the problem of poor image quality and cannot cover all types of dangerous objects. In this paper, a terahertz image recognition algorithm based on Vector Quantized-Variational Autoencoder (VQ-VAE) is proposed. The algorithm realizes image data enhancement through dynamically learned prior, and discrete potential space is used to efficiently identify abnormal objects outside the training set. In order to improve the network recognition performance, the attention CBAM module is introduced to increase the attention ratio of the key target area. The algorithm embeds Center Loss metric learning module into the network frame to increase the inter-class distance and reduce the intra-class distance, thereby improving the clustering and generalization performance. The experimental verification is carried out on the actual collected terahertz security image data set. The experimental results show that the improved and optimized VQ-VAE image recognition network is significantly better than the convolutional neural network in recognition accuracy and has better generalization ability.

articleTitle: Fully Adaptive Constant Module Sequence Set Design for Waveform-Agile Coherent Radar System in the Presence of Signal-Dependent Clutter
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: With increased degrees of freedom of the transmitter, waveform-agile radar system can get performance improvement by changing its transmission on-the-fly in response to target detection's requirement. In literature, the existing cognitive radar transmit waveform design is based on a single dimension. In order to make full use of the degree of freedom and power of the transmission signal, this paper studies the two-dimensional transmission waveform optimization problem, and optimizes the transmission waveform in both fast and slow time dimensions. We first construct a new waveform-agile model called fully adaptive constant mode sequence set (FACMSS), and then implement two-dimensional waveform optimization by shaping the ambiguity function redefined on the adaptive matched filter bank(AFA) in the presence of signal-dependent clutter, and finally propose a joint inter and intra-pulse modulation optimization algorithm (JIIMOA) to solve the problem. Numerical examples show the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Feedback Learning Segmentation Algorithm for Medical Images of Breast Cancer Incorporating Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 14th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS)
abstract: The study of breast cancer image lesion segmentation algorithms is gradually playing an increasingly important role in the medical field to assist physicians in diagnosis. To further segment lesions precisely, a network model with UNet as a substrate and a fusion of attention mechanisms is proposed. The model is trained using breast cancer image data.
